title: 四季養生
summary: 春生夏長秋收冬藏的飲食起居。
summaryEn: Spring growth, summer flourishing, autumn harvest, winter storage.

title: 感冒
summary: 風寒（荊防敗毒散）、風熱（銀翹散）、暑濕（新加香薷飲）、氣虛（參蘇飲）。
summaryEn: Wind-cold, wind-heat, summer-damp and qi-deficient patterns.

title: 咳嗽
summary: 外感風寒／風熱／風燥；內傷痰濕／痰熱／肝火／肺陰虛。
summaryEn: External wind-cold/heat/dryness; internal phlegm-damp/heat, liver fire and lung yin deficiency.

title: 哮病與喘證
summary: 發作期寒哮（射干麻黃湯）／熱哮（定喘湯）；緩解期肺脾腎虛。
summaryEn: Cold/heat wheezing in attack; lung–spleen–kidney deficiency in remission.

title: 肺脹
summary: COPD 相關：痰濁壅肺、痰熱鬱肺、肺腎氣虛。
summaryEn: COPD-related: turbid phlegm, phlegm-heat and lung–kidney qi deficiency.

title: 心悸
summary: 心虛膽怯、心血不足、陰虛火旺、心陽不振、水飲凌心、瘀阻心脈。
summaryEn: Six classical patterns from timidity to stasis obstructing the heart vessels.

title: 胸痹
summary: 心血瘀阻（血府逐瘀湯）、痰濁閉阻（瓜蔞薤白半夏湯）、寒凝、氣陰兩虛。
summaryEn: Blood stasis, phlegm obstruction, cold congealing and qi–yin deficiency.

title: 不寐
summary: 肝火擾心、痰熱、心脾兩虛（歸脾湯）、心腎不交、心膽氣虛。
summaryEn: Liver fire, phlegm-heat, heart–spleen deficiency, heart–kidney disharmony and gallbladder timidity.

title: 鬱證
summary: 肝氣鬱結（柴胡疏肝散）、氣鬱化火、痰氣鬱結、心神失養（甘麥大棗湯）。
summaryEn: Liver constraint, constraint transforming into fire, phlegm-qi binding and heart-spirit malnourishment.

title: 癇證（癲癇）
summary: 風痰閉阻、痰火擾神、瘀阻腦絡、心脾兩虛、肝腎陰虛。
summaryEn: Wind-phlegm, phlegm-fire, stasis, deficiency patterns.

title: 頭痛
summary: 外感三證與內傷肝陽、血虛、痰濁、腎虛、瘀血；分經用藥（太陽羌活、陽明白芷、少陽柴胡、厥陰吳茱萸）。
summaryEn: External and internal patterns with channel-specific guiding herbs.

title: 眩暈
summary: 肝陽上亢（天麻鉤藤飲）、痰濕中阻（半夏白朮天麻湯）、氣血虧虛、腎精不足、瘀血。
summaryEn: Ascending liver yang, phlegm-damp, qi–blood deficiency, kidney essence insufficiency and stasis.

title: 中風
summary: 中經絡／中臟腑、閉證脫證；恢復期補陽還五湯。
summaryEn: Channel vs organ stroke, closed vs collapse; Buyang Huanwu Tang in recovery.

title: 顫證（帕金森）
summary: 風陽內動、痰熱風動、氣血虧虛、髓海不足、陽氣虛衰。
summaryEn: Internal wind, phlegm-heat, deficiency and marrow insufficiency patterns.

title: 癡呆
summary: 髓海不足、脾腎兩虛、痰濁蒙竅、瘀血內阻。
summaryEn: Marrow insufficiency, spleen–kidney deficiency, phlegm clouding and stasis.

title: 胃痛
summary: 寒邪客胃、飲食停滯、肝氣犯胃、濕熱、瘀血、胃陰虛、脾胃虛寒（黃芪建中湯）。
summaryEn: Seven patterns from cold invasion to spleen–stomach deficiency cold.

title: 痞滿
summary: 功能性消化不良：邪熱內陷、飲食、痰濕、肝鬱、脾胃虛弱。
summaryEn: Functional dyspepsia patterns.

title: 嘔吐與呃逆
summary: 外邪、食滯、痰飲、肝氣、脾胃虛寒、胃陰不足。
summaryEn: External, food, phlegm-fluids, liver qi and deficiency patterns.

title: 泄瀉
summary: 寒濕（藿香正氣散）、濕熱（葛根芩連湯）、食滯、肝鬱乘脾（痛瀉要方）、脾虛（參苓白朮散）、腎陽虛（四神丸）。
summaryEn: Cold-damp, damp-heat, food stagnation, liver overacting spleen, spleen deficiency and kidney yang deficiency.

title: 便秘
summary: 熱秘（麻子仁丸）、氣秘（六磨湯）、冷秘、虛秘（氣虛／血虛／陰虛／陽虛）。
summaryEn: Heat, qi, cold and deficiency constipation.

title: 痢疾
summary: 濕熱痢（芍藥湯）、疫毒痢（白頭翁湯）、寒濕、休息痢。
summaryEn: Damp-heat, epidemic-toxin, cold-damp and recurrent dysentery.

title: 腹痛與腹脹
summary: 寒凝、濕熱、食積、氣滯、瘀血、中虛臟寒。
summaryEn: Cold, damp-heat, food, qi, stasis and deficiency patterns.

title: 黃疸
summary: 陽黃（茵陳蒿湯）、陰黃（茵陳朮附湯）、急黃。
summaryEn: Yang jaundice, yin jaundice and acute jaundice.

title: 脅痛
summary: 肝鬱氣滯、肝膽濕熱、瘀血阻絡、肝陰不足（一貫煎）。
summaryEn: Liver constraint, damp-heat, stasis and liver yin deficiency.

title: 鼓脹
summary: 氣滯濕阻、寒濕困脾、濕熱、肝脾血瘀、脾腎陽虛、肝腎陰虛。
summaryEn: Six patterns of ascites.

title: 水腫
summary: 陽水（風水泛濫越婢加朮湯、濕毒浸淫）與陰水（脾陽虛實脾飲、腎陽衰微真武湯）。
summaryEn: Yang oedema (wind-water, damp-toxin) and yin oedema (spleen/kidney yang deficiency).

title: 淋證
summary: 熱淋（八正散）、石淋、血淋、氣淋、膏淋、勞淋。
summaryEn: Heat, stone, blood, qi, unctuous and taxation strangury.

title: 癃閉
summary: 膀胱濕熱、肺熱壅盛、肝鬱氣滯、尿路阻塞、脾氣不升、腎陽衰憊。
summaryEn: Six patterns of retention.

title: 腰痛
summary: 寒濕、濕熱、瘀血、腎虛（左歸丸／右歸丸）。
summaryEn: Cold-damp, damp-heat, stasis and kidney deficiency.

title: 痹證
summary: 行痹、痛痹、著痹、熱痹（白虎加桂枝湯）與尪痹。
summaryEn: Wind, cold, damp and heat bi; deforming bi.

title: 痿證
summary: 肺熱津傷、濕熱浸淫、脾胃虛弱、肝腎虧損、脈絡瘀阻。
summaryEn: Lung heat, damp-heat, spleen–stomach deficiency, liver–kidney depletion and stasis.

title: 消渴（糖尿病）
summary: 上消肺熱（消渴方）、中消胃熱（玉女煎）、下消腎陰虛（六味地黃丸）、陰陽兩虛（金匱腎氣丸）。
summaryEn: Upper, middle and lower wasting with yin/yang deficiency.

title: 虛勞
summary: 氣血陰陽諸虛的補益原則。
summaryEn: Tonification principles for qi, blood, yin and yang deficiency.

title: 血證
summary: 鼻衄、齒衄、咳血、吐血、便血、尿血、紫斑的治火治氣治血。
summaryEn: Epistaxis, gum bleeding, haemoptysis, haematemesis, melaena, haematuria and purpura.

title: 汗證
summary: 自汗（玉屏風散）、盜汗（當歸六黃湯）。
summaryEn: Spontaneous and night sweating.

title: 內傷發熱

summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: One finger-breadth anterosuperior to the mandibular angle at the masseter prominence. Indications: toothache, facial paralysis, trismus.

title: ST7 下關（Xiaguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：顴弓下緣與下頜切跡之間凹陷，閉口取穴。主治：齒痛、耳聾耳鳴、口歪、顳顎關節痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Below the zygomatic arch in the mandibular notch, with the mouth closed. Indications: toothache, deafness, tinnitus, TMJ pain.

title: ST8 頭維（Touwei）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：額角髮際上0.5寸，頭正中線旁4.5寸。主治：頭痛、目眩、流淚。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 0.5 cun within the anterior hairline at the corner of the forehead, 4.5 cun lateral to the midline. Indications: headache, dizziness.

title: ST9 人迎（Renying）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：喉結旁1.5寸，胸鎖乳突肌前緣，頸總動脈搏動處。主治：咽喉腫痛、氣喘、高血壓、瘰癧。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 1.5 cun lateral to the laryngeal prominence at the anterior border of the SCM on the carotid pulse. Indications: sore throat, asthma, hypertension.

title: ST10 水突（Shuitu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：人迎與氣舍連線中點。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、咽痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Midway between ST9 and ST11. Indications: cough, asthma, sore throat.

title: ST11 氣舍（Qishe）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：鎖骨內側端上緣，胸鎖乳突肌兩頭之間。主治：咽痛、氣喘、頸項強痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: At the upper border of the medial clavicle between the two heads of the SCM. Indications: sore throat, asthma, stiff neck.

title: ST12 缺盆（Quepen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：鎖骨上窩中央，前正中線旁4寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、咽痛、缺盆痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Centre of the supraclavicular fossa, 4 cun lateral to the midline. Indications: cough, asthma, sore throat.

title: ST13 氣戶（Qihu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：鎖骨下緣，前正中線旁4寸。主治：咳喘、胸脹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Below the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the midline. Indications: cough, chest fullness.

title: ST14 庫房（Kufang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第1肋間隙，前正中線旁4寸。主治：咳喘、胸脅脹痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 1st intercostal space, 4 cun lateral. Indications: cough, chest pain.

title: ST15 屋翳（Wuyi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第2肋間隙，前正中線旁4寸。主治：咳喘、乳癰。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 2nd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral. Indications: cough, mastitis.

title: ST16 膺窗（Yingchuang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第3肋間隙，前正中線旁4寸。主治：咳喘、乳癰、胸痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 3rd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral. Indications: cough, mastitis, chest pain.

title: ST17 乳中（Ruzhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：乳頭中央。主治：（定位標誌，不針不灸）。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Centre of the nipple. Indications: landmark only; no needling or moxibustion.

title: ST18 乳根（Rugen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：乳頭直下，第5肋間隙。主治：乳癰、乳少、咳喘、胸痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Directly below the nipple in the 5th intercostal space. Indications: mastitis, insufficient lactation, cough.

title: ST19 不容（Burong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上6寸，前正中線旁2寸。主治：腹脹、嘔吐、胃痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 6 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal distension, vomiting.

title: ST20 承滿（Chengman）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上5寸，旁開2寸。主治：胃痛、腹脹、食少。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 5 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: stomach pain, distension.

title: ST21 梁門（Liangmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上4寸，旁開2寸。主治：胃痛、嘔吐、食慾不振。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 4 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: stomach pain, vomiting, poor appetite.

title: ST22 關門（Guanmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上3寸，旁開2寸。主治：腹痛、腹脹、泄瀉。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 3 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea.

title: ST23 太乙（Taiyi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上2寸，旁開2寸。主治：胃痛、心煩、癲狂。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 2 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: stomach pain, agitation.

title: ST24 滑肉門（Huaroumen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍上1寸，旁開2寸。主治：胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 1 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: stomach pain, vomiting.

title: ST25 天樞（Tianshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍中旁開2寸（大腸募穴）。主治：腹痛腹脹、便秘、泄瀉、痢疾、月經不調。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 2 cun lateral to the umbilicus (front-mu of the large intestine). Indications: abdominal pain, constipation, diarrhoea, dysentery, irregular menses.

title: ST26 外陵（Wailing）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍下1寸，旁開2寸。主治：腹痛、疝氣、痛經。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 1 cun below the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, hernia, dysmenorrhoea.

title: ST27 大巨（Daju）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍下2寸，旁開2寸。主治：小腹脹滿、小便不利、遺精。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 2 cun below the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: lower abdominal fullness, dysuria.

title: ST28 水道（Shuidao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍下3寸，旁開2寸。主治：小腹脹、小便不利、痛經。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 3 cun below the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: lower abdominal distension, dysuria, dysmenorrhoea.

title: ST29 歸來（Guilai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍下4寸，旁開2寸。主治：腹痛、疝氣、月經不調、帶下。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 4 cun below the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, hernia, irregular menses.

title: ST30 氣衝（Qichong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：臍下5寸，旁開2寸，腹股溝動脈外側。主治：腹痛、疝氣、月經不調。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 5 cun below the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral, lateral to the femoral artery. Indications: abdominal pain, hernia.

title: ST31 髀關（Biguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：髂前上棘與髕底外緣連線上，平會陰，縫匠肌外側凹陷。主治：腰腿痛、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: On the ASIS–patella line level with the perineum, lateral to the sartorius. Indications: hip-leg pain, lower-limb paralysis.

title: ST32 伏兔（Futu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：髂前上棘與髕底外緣連線上，髕底上6寸。主治：腰腿痛、膝冷、下肢麻痹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 6 cun above the lateral patellar base on the ASIS line. Indications: leg pain, knee cold, numbness.

title: ST33 陰市（Yinshi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：髕底上3寸。主治：腿膝痿痹、腹脹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 3 cun above the lateral patellar base. Indications: leg paralysis, distension.

title: ST34 梁丘（Liangqiu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：髕底上2寸（郄穴）。主治：急性胃痛、膝腫痛、乳癰。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 2 cun above the lateral patellar base (xi-cleft). Indications: acute stomach pain, knee pain, mastitis.

title: ST35 犢鼻（Dubi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：屈膝，髕韌帶外側凹陷（外膝眼）。主治：膝痛、屈伸不利。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: With the knee flexed, in the depression lateral to the patellar ligament. Indications: knee pain and stiffness.

title: ST36 足三里（Zusanli）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：犢鼻下3寸，脛骨前嵴外一橫指（合穴、胃下合穴）。主治：胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、虛勞、下肢痿痹、保健要穴；肚腹三里留。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 3 cun below ST35, one finger-breadth lateral to the tibial crest (he-sea; lower he-sea of the stomach). Indications: stomach pain, vomiting, distension, diarrhoea, constipation, fatigue, leg weakness; the premier tonifying point.

title: ST37 上巨虛（Shangjuxu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：犢鼻下6寸（大腸下合穴）。主治：腹痛、泄瀉、痢疾、便秘、腸癰。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 6 cun below ST35 (lower he-sea of the large intestine). Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea, dysentery, appendicitis.

title: ST38 條口（Tiaokou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：犢鼻下8寸。主治：肩痛（透承山）、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 8 cun below ST35. Indications: shoulder pain (toward BL57), leg paralysis.

title: ST39 下巨虛（Xiajuxu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：犢鼻下9寸（小腸下合穴）。主治：小腹痛、泄瀉、乳癰、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 9 cun below ST35 (lower he-sea of the small intestine). Indications: lower abdominal pain, diarrhoea, mastitis.

title: ST40 豐隆（Fenglong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：外踝尖上8寸，脛骨前嵴外2橫指（絡穴）。主治：痰多咳喘、頭痛眩暈、癲狂、下肢痿痹；化痰要穴。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 8 cun above the lateral malleolus, two finger-breadths lateral to the tibial crest (luo). Indications: profuse phlegm, cough, dizziness, mania; the phlegm point.

title: ST41 解溪（Jiexi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：踝關節前面中央凹陷，拇長伸肌腱與趾長伸肌腱之間（經穴）。主治：頭痛、眩暈、踝痛、腹脹。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Centre of the anterior ankle between the EHL and EDL tendons (jing-river). Indications: headache, dizziness, ankle pain.

title: ST42 衝陽（Chongyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：足背最高處，足背動脈搏動處（原穴）。主治：口歪、足痿、胃痛、癲狂。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: At the highest point of the dorsum on the dorsalis pedis pulse (yuan-source). Indications: facial paralysis, foot weakness, stomach pain.

title: ST43 陷谷（Xiangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第2、3蹠骨結合部前方凹陷（輸穴）。主治：面浮水腫、腸鳴腹痛、足背腫痛。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Distal to the junction of the 2nd and 3rd metatarsals (shu-stream). Indications: facial oedema, borborygmus, foot pain.

title: ST44 內庭（Neiting）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第2、3趾間縫紋端（滎穴）。主治：齒痛、咽痛、鼻衄、胃熱、腹脹泄瀉。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: Proximal to the web between the 2nd and 3rd toes (ying-spring). Indications: toothache, sore throat, epistaxis, stomach heat.

title: ST45 厲兌（Lidui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足陽明胃經。定位：第2趾外側趾甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：面腫、齒痛、鼻衄、多夢、癲狂、熱病。
summaryEn: Stomach channel of foot-yangming. Location: 0.1 cun from the lateral corner of the 2nd toenail (jing-well). Indications: facial swelling, toothache, dream-disturbed sleep, mania.

title: SP1 隱白（Yinbai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：足大趾內側趾甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：月經過多、崩漏、便血、癲狂、多夢。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 0.1 cun from the medial corner of the great toenail (jing-well). Indications: menorrhagia, flooding, blood in stool, mania.

title: SP2 大都（Dadu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：足大趾內側，第1蹠趾關節前下方赤白肉際（滎穴）。主治：腹脹、胃痛、泄瀉、熱病無汗。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: Distal and inferior to the 1st MTP joint at the skin junction (ying-spring). Indications: abdominal distension, stomach pain, diarrhoea.

title: SP3 太白（Taibai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第1蹠趾關節後下方赤白肉際（輸穴、原穴）。主治：胃痛、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、體重節痛。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: Proximal and inferior to the 1st MTP joint (shu-stream, yuan-source). Indications: stomach pain, distension, diarrhoea, constipation, heaviness.

title: SP4 公孫（Gongsun）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第1蹠骨基底部前下方赤白肉際（絡穴、八脈交會通衝脈）。主治：胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、泄瀉、心煩失眠。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: Anteroinferior to the base of the 1st metatarsal (luo; confluent with chong mai). Indications: stomach pain, vomiting, distension, diarrhoea, insomnia.

title: SP5 商丘（Shangqiu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：內踝前下方凹陷，舟骨結節與內踝尖連線中點（經穴）。主治：腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、踝痛、黃疸。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: Anteroinferior to the medial malleolus midway to the navicular tuberosity (jing-river). Indications: distension, diarrhoea, constipation, ankle pain.

title: SP6 三陰交（Sanyinjiao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：內踝尖上3寸，脛骨內側緣後方（足三陰交會）。主治：月經不調、痛經、帶下、不孕、滯產、遺精、遺尿、失眠、下肢痿痹；婦科要穴。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 3 cun above the medial malleolus posterior to the tibial border (meeting of the three leg yin). Indications: irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, infertility, delayed labour, enuresis, insomnia; the key gynaecological point.

title: SP7 漏谷（Lougu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：內踝尖上6寸，脛骨內側緣後方。主治：腹脹、腸鳴、小便不利、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 6 cun above the medial malleolus. Indications: distension, borborygmus, dysuria.

title: SP8 地機（Diji）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：陰陵泉下3寸（郄穴）。主治：痛經、崩漏、腹脹、水腫、小便不利。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 3 cun below SP9 (xi-cleft). Indications: dysmenorrhoea, flooding, distension, oedema.

title: SP9 陰陵泉（Yinlingquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：脛骨內側髁後下方凹陷處（合穴）。主治：腹脹、水腫、黃疸、泄瀉、小便不利、膝痛；利濕要穴。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: In the depression posteroinferior to the medial tibial condyle (he-sea). Indications: distension, oedema, jaundice, diarrhoea, dysuria, knee pain; the dampness point.

title: SP10 血海（Xuehai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：髕底內側端上2寸，股內側肌隆起處。主治：月經不調、崩漏、癮疹、濕疹、膝痛。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 2 cun above the medial patellar base on the vastus medialis. Indications: irregular menses, flooding, urticaria, eczema, knee pain.

title: SP11 箕門（Jimen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：血海與衝門連線上，血海上6寸。主治：小便不利、遺尿、腹股溝腫痛。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 6 cun above SP10 on the SP10–SP12 line. Indications: dysuria, enuresis, groin swelling.

title: SP12 衝門（Chongmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：腹股溝外側，恥骨聯合上緣中點旁3.5寸，股動脈外側。主治：腹痛、疝氣、崩漏、帶下。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: At the lateral groin, 3.5 cun lateral to the superior border of the symphysis, lateral to the femoral artery. Indications: abdominal pain, hernia, flooding.

title: SP13 府舍（Fushe）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：衝門上0.7寸，前正中線旁4寸。主治：腹痛、疝氣、積聚。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 0.7 cun above SP12, 4 cun lateral to the midline. Indications: abdominal pain, hernia, masses.

title: SP14 腹結（Fujie）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：臍下1.3寸，旁開4寸。主治：腹痛、泄瀉、疝氣。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 1.3 cun below the umbilicus, 4 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea, hernia.

title: SP15 大橫（Daheng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：臍中旁開4寸。主治：腹痛、泄瀉、便秘。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 4 cun lateral to the umbilicus. Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation.

title: SP16 腹哀（Fuai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：臍上3寸，旁開4寸。主治：腹痛、消化不良、便秘、痢疾。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 3 cun above the umbilicus, 4 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, indigestion, constipation.

title: SP17 食竇（Shidou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第5肋間隙，前正中線旁6寸。主治：胸脅脹痛、噯氣、腹脹。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 5th intercostal space, 6 cun lateral. Indications: chest-hypochondriac pain, belching.

title: SP18 天溪（Tianxi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第4肋間隙，旁開6寸。主治：胸痛、咳嗽、乳癰、乳少。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 4th intercostal space, 6 cun lateral. Indications: chest pain, cough, mastitis, lactation.

title: SP19 胸鄉（Xiongxiang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第3肋間隙，旁開6寸。主治：胸脅脹痛。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 3rd intercostal space, 6 cun lateral. Indications: chest-hypochondriac pain.

title: SP20 周榮（Zhourong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：第2肋間隙，旁開6寸。主治：咳嗽、氣逆、胸脅脹滿。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: 2nd intercostal space, 6 cun lateral. Indications: cough, chest fullness.

title: SP21 大包（Dabao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陰脾經。定位：腋中線上，第6肋間隙（脾之大絡）。主治：全身疼痛、四肢無力、胸脅痛。
summaryEn: Spleen channel of foot-taiyin. Location: On the mid-axillary line in the 6th intercostal space (great luo of the spleen). Indications: generalised pain, weakness of the limbs, chest pain.

title: HT1 極泉（Jiquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：腋窩頂點，腋動脈搏動處。主治：心痛、上肢不遂、腋臭、脅痛。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: At the apex of the axilla on the axillary artery. Indications: heart pain, hemiplegia of the arm, axillary odour.

title: HT2 青靈（Qingling）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：肘橫紋上3寸，肱二頭肌內側溝。主治：頭痛、脅痛、肩臂痛。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: 3 cun above the cubital crease in the medial bicipital groove. Indications: headache, hypochondriac pain, arm pain.

title: HT3 少海（Shaohai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：屈肘，肘橫紋內側端與肱骨內上髁連線中點（合穴）。主治：心痛、肘臂攣痛、瘰癧、手顫。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: With the elbow flexed, midway between the medial end of the cubital crease and the medial epicondyle (he-sea). Indications: heart pain, elbow contracture, scrofula, hand tremor.

title: HT4 靈道（Lingdao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：腕橫紋上1.5寸，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側（經穴）。主治：心痛、暴喑、肘臂攣痛。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: 1.5 cun above the wrist crease radial to the FCU tendon (jing-river). Indications: heart pain, sudden loss of voice.

title: HT5 通里（Tongli）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：腕橫紋上1寸（絡穴）。主治：心悸、暴喑、舌強、腕臂痛。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: 1 cun above the wrist crease (luo). Indications: palpitations, aphasia, stiff tongue.

title: HT6 陰郄（Yinxi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：腕橫紋上0.5寸（郄穴）。主治：心痛、驚悸、盜汗、吐血。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: 0.5 cun above the wrist crease (xi-cleft). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, night sweats, haematemesis.

title: HT7 神門（Shenmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：腕橫紋尺側端，尺側腕屈肌腱橈側凹陷（輸穴、原穴）。主治：心痛、心煩、失眠、健忘、癲狂癇、驚悸；安神要穴。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: At the ulnar end of the wrist crease radial to the FCU tendon (shu-stream, yuan-source). Indications: heart pain, agitation, insomnia, forgetfulness, epilepsy; the calming point.

title: HT8 少府（Shaofu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：握拳，小指尖下，第4、5掌骨之間（滎穴）。主治：心悸、胸痛、小便不利、陰癢、掌中熱。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: With a fist, where the little finger tip lands between the 4th and 5th metacarpals (ying-spring). Indications: palpitations, chest pain, dysuria, pruritus vulvae.

title: HT9 少衝（Shaochong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陰心經。定位：小指橈側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：心悸、心痛、胸脅痛、昏迷、熱病。
summaryEn: Heart channel of hand-shaoyin. Location: 0.1 cun from the radial corner of the little fingernail (jing-well). Indications: palpitations, heart pain, coma, febrile disease.

title: SI1 少澤（Shaoze）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：小指尺側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：乳癰、乳少、頭痛、目翳、昏迷。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: 0.1 cun from the ulnar corner of the little fingernail (jing-well). Indications: mastitis, insufficient lactation, headache, coma.

title: SI2 前谷（Qiangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：微握拳，第5掌指關節前尺側凹陷（滎穴）。主治：頭痛、目痛、耳鳴、咽痛、乳少。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Distal to the 5th MCP joint on the ulnar side (ying-spring). Indications: headache, eye pain, tinnitus, sore throat.

title: SI3 後溪（Houxi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：微握拳，第5掌指關節後尺側遠側掌橫紋頭赤白肉際（輸穴、八脈交會通督脈）。主治：頭項強痛、腰痛、癲狂癇、瘧疾、手指攣急、盜汗。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Proximal to the 5th MCP joint at the end of the palmar crease (shu-stream; confluent with du mai). Indications: headache and stiff neck, low back pain, epilepsy, malaria, finger spasm.

title: SI4 腕骨（Wangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：手掌尺側，第5掌骨基底與三角骨之間凹陷（原穴）。主治：頭項強痛、黃疸、腕痛、消渴。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: On the ulnar palm between the base of the 5th metacarpal and the triquetral (yuan-source). Indications: headache, jaundice, wrist pain.

title: SI5 陽谷（Yanggu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：腕背橫紋尺側端，尺骨莖突與三角骨之間（經穴）。主治：頭痛、目眩、耳鳴、腕痛、癲狂。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: At the ulnar end of the dorsal wrist crease between the ulnar styloid and the triquetral (jing-river). Indications: headache, dizziness, tinnitus.

title: SI6 養老（Yanglao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：屈肘掌心向胸，尺骨莖突橈側骨縫凹陷（郄穴）。主治：目視不明、肩背肘臂痛、急性腰痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: With the palm facing the chest, in the cleft on the radial side of the ulnar styloid (xi-cleft). Indications: blurred vision, shoulder-arm pain, acute low back pain.

title: SI7 支正（Zhizheng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：陽谷與小海連線上，腕背橫紋上5寸（絡穴）。主治：頭痛、項強、肘臂痛、癲狂。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: 5 cun above the wrist crease on the SI5–SI8 line (luo). Indications: headache, stiff neck, elbow pain.

title: SI8 小海（Xiaohai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：屈肘，尺骨鷹嘴與肱骨內上髁之間凹陷（合穴）。主治：肘臂痛、癲癇。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: With the elbow flexed, between the olecranon and the medial epicondyle (he-sea). Indications: elbow pain, epilepsy.

title: SI9 肩貞（Jianzhen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：腋後紋頭上1寸。主治：肩臂痛、上肢不遂、瘰癧。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: 1 cun above the posterior axillary fold. Indications: shoulder pain, arm paralysis.

title: SI10 臑俞（Naoshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：腋後紋頭直上，肩胛岡下緣凹陷。主治：肩臂痛、瘰癧。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Directly above the posterior axillary fold below the scapular spine. Indications: shoulder pain.

title: SI11 天宗（Tianzong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：肩胛岡下窩中央，約岡下緣與肩胛下角之間上1/3處。主治：肩胛痛、氣喘、乳癰。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Centre of the infraspinous fossa, at the upper third between the spine and the inferior angle. Indications: scapular pain, asthma, mastitis.

title: SI12 秉風（Bingfeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：肩胛岡上窩中央，天宗直上。主治：肩胛痛、上肢酸麻。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Centre of the supraspinous fossa directly above SI11. Indications: scapular pain, arm numbness.

title: SI13 曲垣（Quyuan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：肩胛岡內上端凹陷。主治：肩胛痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Medial end of the supraspinous fossa. Indications: scapular pain.

title: SI14 肩外俞（Jianwaishu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：第1胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：肩背痛、頸項強痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to the lower border of T1. Indications: shoulder-back pain, stiff neck.

title: SI15 肩中俞（Jianzhongshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：第7頸椎棘突下旁開2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、肩背痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: 2 cun lateral to the lower border of C7. Indications: cough, asthma, shoulder pain.

title: SI16 天窗（Tianchuang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：喉結旁，胸鎖乳突肌後緣，平扶突。主治：耳聾耳鳴、咽痛、頸項強痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Posterior border of the SCM level with the laryngeal prominence. Indications: deafness, tinnitus, sore throat.

title: SI17 天容（Tianrong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：下頜角後方，胸鎖乳突肌前緣凹陷。主治：耳聾耳鳴、咽喉腫痛、頸項腫痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Posterior to the mandibular angle at the anterior border of the SCM. Indications: deafness, tinnitus, sore throat.

title: SI18 顴髎（Quanliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：目外眥直下，顴骨下緣凹陷。主治：口眼歪斜、面痛、齒痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Directly below the outer canthus at the lower border of the zygoma. Indications: facial paralysis, facial pain, toothache.

title: SI19 聽宮（Tinggong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手太陽小腸經。定位：耳屏前，下頜骨髁狀突後方，張口凹陷處。主治：耳聾耳鳴、聤耳、齒痛。
summaryEn: Small intestine channel of hand-taiyang. Location: Anterior to the tragus, posterior to the condyle, in the depression with the mouth open. Indications: deafness, tinnitus, otitis.

title: BL1 睛明（Jingming）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：目內眥角稍上方凹陷處。主治：目赤腫痛、流淚、視物不明、近視、夜盲。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Slightly above the inner canthus. Indications: red eyes, lacrimation, blurred vision, myopia.

title: BL2 攢竹（Cuanzhu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：眉頭凹陷中，眶上切跡處。主治：頭痛、眉棱骨痛、目赤、眼瞼下垂、呃逆。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: At the medial end of the eyebrow in the supraorbital notch. Indications: headache, brow pain, red eyes, ptosis, hiccup.

title: BL3 眉衝（Meichong）

summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第6胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、瘧疾、熱病、肩背痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T6. Indications: cough, asthma, malaria, febrile disease.

title: BL46 膈關（Geguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第7胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：胸悶、噯氣、嘔吐、呃逆、脊背強痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T7. Indications: chest oppression, belching, vomiting, hiccup.

title: BL47 魂門（Hunmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第9胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：胸脅痛、嘔吐、泄瀉、背痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T9. Indications: chest-hypochondriac pain, vomiting, diarrhoea.

title: BL48 陽綱（Yanggang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第10胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：腸鳴、腹痛、泄瀉、黃疸、消渴。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T10. Indications: borborygmus, diarrhoea, jaundice.

title: BL49 意舍（Yishe）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第11胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：腹脹、腸鳴、嘔吐、泄瀉。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T11. Indications: distension, vomiting, diarrhoea.

title: BL50 胃倉（Weicang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第12胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：胃脘痛、腹脹、小兒食積、水腫、背痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to T12. Indications: stomach pain, distension, food stagnation.

title: BL51 肓門（Huangmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第1腰椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：腹痛、痞塊、便秘、乳疾。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to L1. Indications: abdominal pain, masses, constipation.

title: BL52 志室（Zhishi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第2腰椎棘突下旁開3寸。主治：遺精、陽痿、小便不利、水腫、腰脊強痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun lateral to L2. Indications: emission, impotence, dysuria, oedema, back pain.

title: BL53 胞肓（Baohuang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第2骶後孔平，骶正中嵴旁3寸。主治：腸鳴、腹脹、便秘、癃閉、腰脊強痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Level with the 2nd posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral. Indications: borborygmus, constipation, retention, back pain.

title: BL54 秩邊（Zhibian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第4骶後孔平，骶正中嵴旁3寸。主治：腰骶痛、下肢痿痹、痔疾、便秘、小便不利。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Level with the 4th posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral. Indications: lumbosacral pain, sciatica, haemorrhoids, dysuria.

title: BL55 合陽（Heyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：委中下2寸。主治：腰脊強痛、下肢痿痹、崩漏。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 2 cun below BL40. Indications: back pain, leg paralysis, flooding.

title: BL56 承筋（Chengjin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：合陽與承山連線中點，腓腸肌肌腹中央。主治：小腿痛、痔疾、腰背拘急。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Midway between BL55 and BL57 in the belly of the gastrocnemius. Indications: calf pain, haemorrhoids.

title: BL57 承山（Chengshan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：腓腸肌兩肌腹之間凹陷頂端，伸小腿時人字紋尖下。主治：腰腿拘急疼痛、痔疾、便秘、腓腸肌痙攣。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: At the apex of the depression between the two bellies of the gastrocnemius. Indications: back-leg pain, haemorrhoids, constipation, calf cramp.

title: BL58 飛揚（Feiyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：崑崙上7寸，承山外下方1寸（絡穴）。主治：頭痛、目眩、鼻衄、腰腿痛、痔疾。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 7 cun above BL60, 1 cun inferolateral to BL57 (luo). Indications: headache, dizziness, epistaxis, back-leg pain, haemorrhoids.

title: BL59 跗陽（Fuyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：崑崙上3寸（陽蹻郄穴）。主治：頭痛、腰骶痛、下肢痿痹、外踝腫痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 3 cun above BL60 (xi-cleft of yang qiao). Indications: headache, lumbosacral pain, ankle swelling.

title: BL60 崑崙（Kunlun）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：外踝尖與跟腱之間凹陷（經穴）。主治：頭痛、項強、目眩、鼻衄、腰痛、足跟痛、滯產、癲癇。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Between the lateral malleolus and the Achilles tendon (jing-river). Indications: headache, stiff neck, dizziness, low back pain, heel pain, delayed labour.

title: BL61 僕參（Pucan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：崑崙直下，跟骨外側赤白肉際。主治：下肢痿痹、足跟痛、癲癇。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Directly below BL60 at the lateral calcaneus. Indications: leg paralysis, heel pain, epilepsy.

title: BL62 申脈（Shenmai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：外踝直下方凹陷（八脈交會通陽蹻）。主治：頭痛、眩暈、癲狂癇、失眠、腰腿痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Directly below the lateral malleolus (confluent with yang qiao). Indications: headache, dizziness, epilepsy, insomnia, back-leg pain.

title: BL63 金門（Jinmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：外踝前緣直下，骰骨下緣凹陷（郄穴）。主治：頭痛、癲癇、小兒驚風、腰痛、下肢痿痹、外踝痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Below the anterior border of the lateral malleolus at the lower border of the cuboid (xi-cleft). Indications: headache, epilepsy, infantile convulsion, low back pain.

title: BL64 京骨（Jinggu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第5蹠骨粗隆下方赤白肉際（原穴）。主治：頭痛、項強、目翳、癲癇、腰腿痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Below the tuberosity of the 5th metatarsal (yuan-source). Indications: headache, stiff neck, epilepsy, back-leg pain.

title: BL65 束骨（Shugu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第5蹠趾關節後方赤白肉際（輸穴）。主治：頭痛、項強、目眩、癲狂、腰腿痛。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Proximal to the 5th MTP joint (shu-stream). Indications: headache, stiff neck, dizziness, mania.

title: BL66 足通谷（Zutonggu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：第5蹠趾關節前方赤白肉際（滎穴）。主治：頭痛、項強、目眩、鼻衄、癲狂。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: Distal to the 5th MTP joint (ying-spring). Indications: headache, stiff neck, epistaxis.

title: BL67 至陰（Zhiyin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足太陽膀胱經。定位：足小趾外側趾甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：胎位不正、滯產、頭痛、目痛、鼻塞、鼻衄。
summaryEn: Bladder channel of foot-taiyang. Location: 0.1 cun from the lateral corner of the little toenail (jing-well). Indications: breech presentation, delayed labour, headache, eye pain, nasal obstruction.

title: KI1 湧泉（Yongquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：足底，蜷足時足前部凹陷，約足底第2、3趾縫與足跟連線前1/3（井穴）。主治：頭頂痛、眩暈、昏厥、癲狂、小兒驚風、失眠、咽痛、足心熱；急救要穴。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: On the sole, in the depression when the foot is flexed, at the anterior third of the line from the 2nd–3rd toe web to the heel (jing-well). Indications: vertex headache, dizziness, syncope, mania, infantile convulsion, insomnia, sore throat; emergency point.

title: KI2 然谷（Rangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：內踝前下方，舟骨粗隆下緣凹陷（滎穴）。主治：月經不調、陰癢、遺精、消渴、泄瀉、咽痛、足背腫痛。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: Below the navicular tuberosity anteroinferior to the medial malleolus (ying-spring). Indications: irregular menses, pruritus vulvae, emission, diabetes, sore throat.

title: KI3 太溪（Taixi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：內踝尖與跟腱之間凹陷（輸穴、原穴）。主治：頭痛目眩、耳鳴耳聾、咽痛齒痛、失眠、遺精陽痿、月經不調、腰痛、消渴、氣喘；補腎要穴。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: Between the medial malleolus and the Achilles tendon (shu-stream, yuan-source). Indications: headache, tinnitus, deafness, sore throat, toothache, insomnia, impotence, irregular menses, low back pain, asthma; the kidney-tonifying point.

title: KI4 大鐘（Dazhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：太溪下0.5寸稍後，跟腱內側前方（絡穴）。主治：咯血、氣喘、癡呆、嗜臥、足跟痛、二便不利。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 0.5 cun below and slightly posterior to KI3, anterior to the Achilles tendon (luo). Indications: haemoptysis, asthma, dementia, heel pain.

title: KI5 水泉（Shuiquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：太溪直下1寸，跟骨結節內側凹陷（郄穴）。主治：月經不調、痛經、陰挺、小便不利。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 1 cun below KI3 on the medial calcaneal tuberosity (xi-cleft). Indications: irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, prolapse, dysuria.

title: KI6 照海（Zhaohai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：內踝尖直下1寸凹陷（八脈交會通陰蹻）。主治：咽喉乾痛、失眠、癲癇、月經不調、陰挺、小便頻數、便秘。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 1 cun directly below the tip of the medial malleolus (confluent with yin qiao). Indications: dry sore throat, insomnia, epilepsy, irregular menses, urinary frequency, constipation.

title: KI7 復溜（Fuliu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：太溪上2寸，跟腱前緣（經穴）。主治：水腫、腹脹、泄瀉、盜汗、熱病無汗、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 2 cun above KI3 anterior to the Achilles tendon (jing-river). Indications: oedema, distension, diarrhoea, night sweats, fever without sweating.

title: KI8 交信（Jiaoxin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：太溪上2寸，復溜前0.5寸，脛骨內側緣後方（陰蹻郄穴）。主治：月經不調、崩漏、陰挺、泄瀉、便秘。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 2 cun above KI3, 0.5 cun anterior to KI7 (xi-cleft of yin qiao). Indications: irregular menses, flooding, prolapse.

title: KI9 築賓（Zhubin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：太溪上5寸，腓腸肌內側肌腹下端（陰維郄穴）。主治：癲狂、疝氣、嘔吐涎沫、小腿痛；解毒。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 5 cun above KI3 at the lower end of the medial gastrocnemius belly (xi-cleft of yin wei). Indications: mania, hernia, vomiting of foam, calf pain.

title: KI10 陰谷（Yingu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：膕窩內側，半腱肌腱與半膜肌腱之間（合穴）。主治：陽痿、疝氣、崩漏、小便不利、膝痛。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: At the medial popliteal fossa between the semitendinosus and semimembranosus tendons (he-sea). Indications: impotence, hernia, flooding, dysuria, knee pain.

title: KI11 橫骨（Henggu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍下5寸，前正中線旁0.5寸。主治：少腹脹痛、小便不利、遺尿、遺精、陽痿。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 5 cun below the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: lower abdominal pain, dysuria, enuresis, impotence.

title: KI12 大赫（Dahe）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍下4寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：遺精、陽痿、帶下、陰挺。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 4 cun below the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: emission, impotence, discharge.

title: KI13 氣穴（Qixue）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍下3寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：月經不調、帶下、小便不利、泄瀉。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 3 cun below the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: irregular menses, discharge, dysuria.

title: KI14 四滿（Siman）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍下2寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：月經不調、帶下、遺精、水腫、小腹痛。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 2 cun below the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: irregular menses, oedema, lower abdominal pain.

title: KI15 中注（Zhongzhu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍下1寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：月經不調、腹痛、便秘。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 1 cun below the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: irregular menses, abdominal pain, constipation.

title: KI16 肓俞（Huangshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍中旁開0.5寸。主治：腹痛、腹脹、嘔吐、便秘、泄瀉。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 0.5 cun lateral to the umbilicus. Indications: abdominal pain, distension, vomiting, constipation.

title: KI17 商曲（Shangqu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍上2寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：腹痛、泄瀉、便秘。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 2 cun above the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation.

title: KI18 石關（Shiguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍上3寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：嘔吐、腹痛、便秘、不孕。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 3 cun above the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: vomiting, abdominal pain, constipation.

title: KI19 陰都（Yindu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍上4寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：腹脹、腹痛、便秘、不孕。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 4 cun above the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: distension, constipation.

title: KI20 腹通谷（Futonggu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍上5寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：腹痛、腹脹、嘔吐、心痛。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 5 cun above the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, vomiting.

title: KI21 幽門（Youmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：臍上6寸，旁開0.5寸。主治：腹痛、嘔吐、泄瀉。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 6 cun above the umbilicus, 0.5 cun lateral. Indications: abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhoea.

title: KI22 步廊（Bulang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：第5肋間隙，前正中線旁2寸。主治：胸痛、咳嗽、氣喘、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 5th intercostal space, 2 cun lateral. Indications: chest pain, cough, asthma.

title: KI23 神封（Shenfeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：第4肋間隙，旁開2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸脅脹痛、乳癰。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 4th intercostal space, 2 cun lateral. Indications: cough, asthma, mastitis.

title: KI24 靈墟（Lingxu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：第3肋間隙，旁開2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸脅脹痛、乳癰。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 3rd intercostal space, 2 cun lateral. Indications: cough, asthma, mastitis.

title: KI25 神藏（Shencang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：第2肋間隙，旁開2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 2nd intercostal space, 2 cun lateral. Indications: cough, asthma, chest pain.

title: KI26 彧中（Yuzhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：第1肋間隙，旁開2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、痰壅、胸脅脹滿。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: 1st intercostal space, 2 cun lateral. Indications: cough, asthma, phlegm.

title: KI27 俞府（Shufu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陰腎經。定位：鎖骨下緣，前正中線旁2寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin. Location: Below the clavicle, 2 cun lateral to the midline. Indications: cough, asthma, chest pain, vomiting.

title: PC1 天池（Tianchi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：第4肋間隙，乳頭外1寸，前正中線旁5寸。主治：胸悶、心煩、咳嗽、乳癰、瘰癧。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: 4th intercostal space, 1 cun lateral to the nipple, 5 cun from the midline. Indications: chest oppression, cough, mastitis.

title: PC2 天泉（Tianquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：腋前紋頭下2寸，肱二頭肌長短頭之間。主治：心痛、胸脅脹痛、咳嗽、上臂痛。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: 2 cun below the anterior axillary fold between the heads of the biceps. Indications: heart pain, chest pain, cough, arm pain.

title: PC3 曲澤（Quze）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：肘橫紋中，肱二頭肌腱尺側凹陷（合穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、熱病、肘臂痛、中暑。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: In the cubital crease ulnar to the biceps tendon (he-sea). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, stomach pain, vomiting, febrile disease, heatstroke.

title: PC4 郄門（Ximen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：腕橫紋上5寸，掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱之間（郄穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、咯血、吐血、癲癇。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: 5 cun above the wrist crease between the palmaris longus and FCR tendons (xi-cleft). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, haemoptysis, epilepsy.

title: PC5 間使（Jianshi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：腕橫紋上3寸，兩腱之間（經穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、瘧疾、癲狂癇。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: 3 cun above the wrist crease between the tendons (jing-river). Indications: heart pain, stomach pain, malaria, mania.

title: PC6 內關（Neiguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：腕橫紋上2寸，掌長肌腱與橈側腕屈肌腱之間（絡穴、八脈交會通陰維）。主治：心痛、心悸、胸悶、胃痛、嘔吐、呃逆、失眠、癲癇、暈車；寬胸止嘔要穴。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: 2 cun above the wrist crease between the palmaris longus and FCR tendons (luo; confluent with yin wei). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, chest oppression, stomach pain, nausea and vomiting, hiccup, insomnia, motion sickness; the master point for the chest and nausea.

title: PC7 大陵（Daling）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：腕掌側橫紋中點，兩腱之間（輸穴、原穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂、腕痛、口臭。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: At the midpoint of the wrist crease between the tendons (shu-stream, yuan-source). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, stomach pain, mania, wrist pain, halitosis.

title: PC8 勞宮（Laogong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：掌心，第2、3掌骨之間偏第3掌骨，握拳中指尖下（滎穴）。主治：心痛、癲狂癇、口瘡、口臭、中暑、鵝掌風。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: On the palm between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, where the middle fingertip lands (ying-spring). Indications: heart pain, mania, mouth ulcers, heatstroke.

title: PC9 中衝（Zhongchong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手厥陰心包經。定位：中指尖端中央（井穴）。主治：中風昏迷、中暑、小兒驚風、熱病、舌強、心痛。
summaryEn: Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin. Location: At the tip of the middle finger (jing-well). Indications: stroke coma, heatstroke, infantile convulsion, febrile disease.

title: TE1 關衝（Guanchong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：無名指尺側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：頭痛、目赤、耳聾、咽痛、熱病、中暑。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 0.1 cun from the ulnar corner of the ring fingernail (jing-well). Indications: headache, red eyes, deafness, sore throat, heatstroke.

title: TE2 液門（Yemen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：第4、5指間縫紋端赤白肉際（滎穴）。主治：頭痛、目赤、耳聾、咽痛、瘧疾、手臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Proximal to the web between the 4th and 5th fingers (ying-spring). Indications: headache, red eyes, deafness, sore throat.

title: TE3 中渚（Zhongzhu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：手背，第4、5掌骨間，掌指關節後凹陷（輸穴）。主治：頭痛、目赤、耳鳴耳聾、咽痛、肩背肘臂痛、手指屈伸不利。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: On the dorsum between the 4th and 5th metacarpals proximal to the MCP joints (shu-stream). Indications: headache, tinnitus, deafness, sore throat, shoulder-arm pain.

title: TE4 陽池（Yangchi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：腕背橫紋中，指總伸肌腱尺側凹陷（原穴）。主治：腕痛、肩臂痛、瘧疾、耳聾、消渴。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: On the dorsal wrist crease ulnar to the extensor digitorum tendon (yuan-source). Indications: wrist pain, malaria, deafness, diabetes.

title: TE5 外關（Waiguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：腕背橫紋上2寸，尺骨與橈骨之間（絡穴、八脈交會通陽維）。主治：熱病、頭痛、頰痛、耳鳴耳聾、脅肋痛、上肢痿痹、手顫。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 2 cun above the dorsal wrist crease between the radius and ulna (luo; confluent with yang wei). Indications: febrile disease, headache, tinnitus, deafness, hypochondriac pain, arm paralysis.

title: TE6 支溝（Zhigou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：腕背橫紋上3寸，尺橈骨之間（經穴）。主治：便秘、脅肋痛、耳鳴耳聾、暴喑、熱病、肩臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 3 cun above the dorsal wrist crease (jing-river). Indications: constipation, hypochondriac pain, tinnitus, sudden hoarseness.

title: TE7 會宗（Huizong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：支溝尺側1橫指，尺骨橈側緣（郄穴）。主治：耳聾、癲癇、上肢痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: One finger-breadth ulnar to TE6 at the radial border of the ulna (xi-cleft). Indications: deafness, epilepsy, arm pain.

title: TE8 三陽絡（Sanyangluo）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：腕背橫紋上4寸，尺橈骨之間。主治：耳聾、暴喑、齒痛、手臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 4 cun above the dorsal wrist crease. Indications: deafness, hoarseness, toothache.

title: TE9 四瀆（Sidu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：肘尖下5寸，尺橈骨之間。主治：耳聾、暴喑、齒痛、咽痛、前臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 5 cun below the olecranon between the radius and ulna. Indications: deafness, hoarseness, toothache.

title: TE10 天井（Tianjing）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：屈肘，尺骨鷹嘴上1寸凹陷（合穴）。主治：偏頭痛、脅肋痛、瘰癧、癲癇、肘臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: With the elbow flexed, 1 cun above the olecranon (he-sea). Indications: migraine, hypochondriac pain, scrofula, elbow pain.

title: TE11 清冷淵（Qinglengyuan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：天井上1寸。主治：頭痛、目黃、肩臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 1 cun above TE10. Indications: headache, yellow eyes, shoulder-arm pain.

title: TE12 消濼（Xiaoluo）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：清冷淵與臑會連線中點。主治：頭痛、項強、臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Midway between TE11 and TE13. Indications: headache, stiff neck, arm pain.

title: TE13 臑會（Naohui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：肩髎下3寸，三角肌後緣。主治：瘰癧、癭氣、肩臂痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: 3 cun below TE14 at the posterior border of the deltoid. Indications: scrofula, goitre, shoulder pain.

title: TE14 肩髎（Jianliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：肩峰後下方，上臂外展時肩髃後方凹陷。主治：肩臂痛、上肢不遂。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Posteroinferior to the acromion, posterior to LI15 when the arm is abducted. Indications: shoulder-arm pain, arm paralysis.

title: TE15 天髎（Tianliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：肩胛骨上角，肩井與曲垣之間。主治：肩臂痛、頸項強痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: At the superior angle of the scapula between GB21 and SI13. Indications: shoulder pain, stiff neck.

title: TE16 天牖（Tianyou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：乳突後下方，胸鎖乳突肌後緣，平下頜角。主治：頭痛、頭暈、項強、耳聾、目痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Posteroinferior to the mastoid at the posterior border of the SCM level with the mandibular angle. Indications: headache, dizziness, stiff neck, deafness.

title: TE17 翳風（Yifeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：耳垂後方，乳突與下頜角之間凹陷。主治：耳鳴耳聾、口眼歪斜、牙關緊閉、頰腫、瘰癧。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Posterior to the earlobe between the mastoid and the mandibular angle. Indications: tinnitus, deafness, facial paralysis, trismus.

title: TE18 瘈脈（Chimai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：乳突中央，翳風與角孫沿耳輪連線的下1/3處。主治：頭痛、耳鳴耳聾、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: On the mastoid at the lower third of the line from TE17 to TE20 along the helix. Indications: headache, tinnitus, infantile convulsion.

title: TE19 顱息（Luxi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：翳風與角孫連線的上1/3處。主治：頭痛、耳鳴、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: At the upper third of the TE17–TE20 line. Indications: headache, tinnitus, infantile convulsion.

title: TE20 角孫（Jiaosun）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：折耳向前，耳尖直上入髮際處。主治：頭痛、目翳、齒痛、頰腫、耳部腫痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: With the ear folded forward, where the apex touches the hairline. Indications: headache, eye disorders, toothache.

title: TE21 耳門（Ermen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：耳屏上切跡前，下頜骨髁狀突後緣，張口凹陷處。主治：耳鳴耳聾、聤耳、齒痛。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: Anterior to the supratragic notch, posterior to the condyle, with the mouth open. Indications: tinnitus, deafness, otorrhoea, toothache.

title: TE22 耳和髎（Erheliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：鬢髮後緣，平耳廓根前方，顳淺動脈後緣。主治：頭痛、耳鳴、牙關緊閉、口歪。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: At the posterior border of the temple hair, anterior to the auricle root, posterior to the superficial temporal artery. Indications: headache, tinnitus, trismus.

title: TE23 絲竹空（Sizhukong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 手少陽三焦經。定位：眉梢凹陷處。主治：頭痛、目赤、眼瞼瞤動、齒痛、癲癇。
summaryEn: Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang. Location: In the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow. Indications: headache, red eyes, eyelid twitching.

title: GB1 瞳子髎（Tongziliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：目外眥旁0.5寸，眶外緣凹陷。主治：頭痛、目赤腫痛、目翳、口眼歪斜。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 0.5 cun lateral to the outer canthus at the orbital rim. Indications: headache, red eyes, visual obstruction, facial paralysis.

title: GB2 聽會（Tinghui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：耳屏間切跡前，下頜骨髁狀突後緣，張口凹陷處。主治：耳鳴耳聾、聤耳、齒痛、口歪、下頜脫臼。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Anterior to the intertragic notch, posterior to the condyle, with the mouth open. Indications: tinnitus, deafness, toothache, facial paralysis, TMJ dislocation.

title: GB3 上關（Shangguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：顴弓上緣，下關直上凹陷。主治：頭痛、耳鳴耳聾、口眼歪斜、齒痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: At the upper border of the zygomatic arch directly above ST7. Indications: headache, tinnitus, deafness, facial paralysis.

title: GB4 頷厭（Hanyan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：頭維與曲鬢弧形連線的上1/4與下3/4交點。主治：偏頭痛、眩暈、耳鳴、癲癇。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: At the junction of the upper quarter and lower three quarters of the ST8–GB7 curve. Indications: migraine, dizziness, tinnitus, epilepsy.

title: GB5 懸顱（Xuanlu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：頭維與曲鬢弧形連線中點。主治：偏頭痛、目赤、齒痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Midpoint of the ST8–GB7 curve. Indications: migraine, red eyes, toothache.

title: GB6 懸釐（Xuanli）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：頭維與曲鬢弧形連線的下1/4與上3/4交點。主治：偏頭痛、目赤、耳鳴。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: At the junction of the lower quarter and upper three quarters of the ST8–GB7 curve. Indications: migraine, red eyes, tinnitus.

title: GB7 曲鬢（Qubin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：耳前鬢角髮際後緣垂線與耳尖水平線交點。主治：頭痛、齒痛、頰腫、牙關緊閉。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Where a vertical line at the posterior temple hairline meets a horizontal line through the ear apex. Indications: headache, toothache, cheek swelling.

title: GB8 率谷（Shuaigu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：耳尖直上入髮際1.5寸。主治：偏頭痛、眩暈、嘔吐、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 1.5 cun directly above the apex of the ear within the hairline. Indications: migraine, dizziness, vomiting, infantile convulsion.

title: GB9 天衝（Tianchong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：耳根後緣直上入髮際2寸，率谷後0.5寸。主治：頭痛、齒齦腫痛、癲癇。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 2 cun above the posterior ear root within the hairline, 0.5 cun posterior to GB8. Indications: headache, gum swelling, epilepsy.

title: GB10 浮白（Fubai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：耳後乳突後上方，天衝與完骨弧形連線的中1/3與上1/3交點。主治：頭痛、耳鳴耳聾、目痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Posterosuperior to the mastoid at the junction of the upper and middle thirds of the GB9–GB12 curve. Indications: headache, tinnitus, deafness.

title: GB11 頭竅陰（Touqiaoyin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：天衝與完骨弧形連線的中1/3與下1/3交點。主治：頭痛、耳鳴耳聾、耳痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: At the junction of the middle and lower thirds of the GB9–GB12 curve. Indications: headache, tinnitus, ear pain.

title: GB12 完骨（Wangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：乳突後下方凹陷處。主治：頭痛、頸項強痛、口眼歪斜、失眠、癲癇。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Posteroinferior to the mastoid process. Indications: headache, stiff neck, facial paralysis, insomnia.

title: GB13 本神（Benshen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：前髮際上0.5寸，神庭旁3寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、癲癇、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 0.5 cun within the anterior hairline, 3 cun lateral to GV24. Indications: headache, dizziness, epilepsy.

title: GB14 陽白（Yangbai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：瞳孔直上，眉上1寸。主治：頭痛、目眩、眼瞼下垂、口眼歪斜、目痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Directly above the pupil, 1 cun above the eyebrow. Indications: headache, ptosis, facial paralysis.

title: GB15 頭臨泣（Toulinqi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：瞳孔直上入髮際0.5寸，神庭與頭維連線中點。主治：頭痛、目眩、流淚、鼻塞、癲癇。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Directly above the pupil, 0.5 cun within the hairline, midway between GV24 and ST8. Indications: headache, dizziness, lacrimation, nasal obstruction.

title: GB16 目窗（Muchuang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：頭臨泣後1寸。主治：頭痛、目赤、目眩、鼻塞。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 1 cun posterior to GB15. Indications: headache, red eyes, dizziness.

title: GB17 正營（Zhengying）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：目窗後1寸。主治：頭痛、目眩、齒痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 1 cun posterior to GB16. Indications: headache, dizziness, toothache.

title: GB18 承靈（Chengling）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：正營後1.5寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、鼻塞、鼻衄。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 1.5 cun posterior to GB17. Indications: headache, dizziness, nasal disorders.

title: GB19 腦空（Naokong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：枕外隆凸上緣外側，風池直上，平腦戶。主治：頭痛、項強、目眩、癲癇。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Lateral to the upper border of the external occipital protuberance, directly above GB20, level with GV17. Indications: headache, stiff neck, dizziness, epilepsy.

title: GB20 風池（Fengchi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：枕骨下，胸鎖乳突肌與斜方肌上端之間凹陷。主治：頭痛、眩暈、項強、目赤痛、鼻塞、耳鳴、感冒、中風、高血壓；祛風要穴。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Below the occiput between the upper ends of the SCM and trapezius. Indications: headache, dizziness, stiff neck, red eyes, nasal obstruction, tinnitus, common cold, stroke, hypertension; the wind point.

title: GB21 肩井（Jianjing）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：肩上，大椎與肩峰連線中點。主治：頭項強痛、肩背痛、上肢不遂、乳癰、難產。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: On the shoulder midway between GV14 and the acromion. Indications: headache, stiff neck, shoulder pain, arm paralysis, mastitis, difficult labour.

title: GB22 淵腋（Yuanye）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：舉臂，腋中線上，第4肋間隙。主治：胸滿、脅痛、腋下腫、臂痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: With the arm raised, on the mid-axillary line in the 4th intercostal space. Indications: chest fullness, hypochondriac pain.

title: GB23 輒筋（Zhejin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：淵腋前1寸，第4肋間隙。主治：胸滿、脅痛、氣喘、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 1 cun anterior to GB22 in the 4th intercostal space. Indications: chest fullness, asthma, vomiting.

title: GB24 日月（Riyue）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：乳頭直下，第7肋間隙（膽募穴）。主治：脅肋痛、黃疸、嘔吐、吞酸、呃逆。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Directly below the nipple in the 7th intercostal space (front-mu of the gallbladder). Indications: hypochondriac pain, jaundice, vomiting, hiccup.

title: GB25 京門（Jingmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第12肋骨游離端下方（腎募穴）。主治：腰痛、脅痛、腹脹、泄瀉、小便不利、水腫。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Below the free end of the 12th rib (front-mu of the kidney). Indications: low back pain, hypochondriac pain, diarrhoea, oedema.

title: GB26 帶脈（Daimai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第11肋骨游離端直下，平臍。主治：月經不調、帶下、疝氣、腰脅痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Directly below the free end of the 11th rib, level with the umbilicus. Indications: irregular menses, discharge, hernia, lumbar pain.

title: GB27 五樞（Wushu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：髂前上棘前方，平臍下3寸。主治：帶下、月經不調、疝氣、腰胯痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Anterior to the ASIS, level 3 cun below the umbilicus. Indications: discharge, irregular menses, hernia.

title: GB28 維道（Weidao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：五樞前下0.5寸。主治：帶下、月經不調、疝氣、陰挺、腰胯痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 0.5 cun anteroinferior to GB27. Indications: discharge, hernia, prolapse.

title: GB29 居髎（Juliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：髂前上棘與股骨大轉子最高點連線中點。主治：腰腿痛、下肢痿痹、疝氣。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Midway between the ASIS and the greater trochanter. Indications: hip-leg pain, paralysis, hernia.

title: GB30 環跳（Huantiao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：側臥屈股，股骨大轉子最高點與骶管裂孔連線的外1/3與中1/3交點。主治：腰胯痛、下肢痿痹、半身不遂、坐骨神經痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Side-lying with the hip flexed, at the junction of the lateral and middle thirds of the line from the greater trochanter to the sacral hiatus. Indications: hip-leg pain, paralysis, hemiplegia, sciatica.

title: GB31 風市（Fengshi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：大腿外側中線，膕橫紋上7寸；直立垂手中指尖處。主治：下肢痿痹、半身不遂、遍身瘙癢。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: On the lateral thigh midline 7 cun above the popliteal crease, where the middle fingertip touches when standing. Indications: leg paralysis, hemiplegia, generalised itching.

title: GB32 中瀆（Zhongdu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：風市下2寸，股外側肌與股二頭肌之間。主治：下肢痿痹、半身不遂。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 2 cun below GB31 between the vastus lateralis and biceps femoris. Indications: leg paralysis.

title: GB33 膝陽關（Xiyangguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：陽陵泉上3寸，股骨外上髁上方凹陷。主治：膝臏腫痛、膕筋攣急、小腿麻木。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 3 cun above GB34 in the depression above the lateral epicondyle of the femur. Indications: knee pain, popliteal contracture.

title: GB34 陽陵泉（Yanglingquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：腓骨小頭前下方凹陷（合穴、膽下合穴、筋會）。主治：脅痛、口苦、嘔吐、黃疸、下肢痿痹、膝腫痛、肩痛、小兒驚風；筋病要穴。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Anteroinferior to the head of the fibula (he-sea; lower he-sea of the gallbladder; hui of sinews). Indications: hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, jaundice, leg paralysis, knee pain, shoulder pain; the sinew point.

title: GB35 陽交（Yangjiao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝尖上7寸，腓骨後緣（陽維郄穴）。主治：胸脅脹滿、下肢痿痹、癲狂。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 7 cun above the lateral malleolus at the posterior border of the fibula (xi-cleft of yang wei). Indications: chest fullness, leg paralysis, mania.

title: GB36 外丘（Waiqiu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝尖上7寸，腓骨前緣（郄穴）。主治：頸項強痛、胸脅痛、下肢痿痹、癲狂。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 7 cun above the lateral malleolus at the anterior border of the fibula (xi-cleft). Indications: stiff neck, chest pain, leg paralysis.

title: GB37 光明（Guangming）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝尖上5寸，腓骨前緣（絡穴）。主治：目痛、夜盲、目視不明、乳房脹痛、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 5 cun above the lateral malleolus at the anterior border of the fibula (luo). Indications: eye pain, night blindness, breast distension.

title: GB38 陽輔（Yangfu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝尖上4寸，腓骨前緣稍前（經穴）。主治：偏頭痛、目外眥痛、脅痛、瘰癧、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 4 cun above the lateral malleolus slightly anterior to the fibula (jing-river). Indications: migraine, outer canthus pain, hypochondriac pain.

title: GB39 懸鐘（絕骨）（Xuanzhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝尖上3寸，腓骨前緣（髓會）。主治：項強、胸脅脹痛、下肢痿痹、半身不遂、痔疾；中風預防。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 3 cun above the lateral malleolus at the anterior border of the fibula (hui of marrow). Indications: stiff neck, chest pain, leg paralysis, hemiplegia; stroke prevention.

title: GB40 丘墟（Qiuxu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：外踝前下方，趾長伸肌腱外側凹陷（原穴）。主治：胸脅痛、下肢痿痹、外踝腫痛、瘧疾。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Anteroinferior to the lateral malleolus lateral to the EDL tendon (yuan-source). Indications: chest pain, ankle swelling, malaria.

title: GB41 足臨泣（Zulinqi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第4、5蹠骨結合部前方，小趾伸肌腱外側凹陷（輸穴、八脈交會通帶脈）。主治：偏頭痛、目赤、脅肋痛、月經不調、乳癰、瘧疾、足跗腫痛。
