summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Distal to the junction of the 4th and 5th metatarsals lateral to the EDL tendon (shu-stream; confluent with dai mai). Indications: migraine, red eyes, hypochondriac pain, irregular menses, mastitis.

title: GB42 地五會（Diwuhui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第4、5蹠骨之間，小趾伸肌腱內側。主治：頭痛、目赤、耳鳴、乳癰、足背腫痛。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Between the 4th and 5th metatarsals medial to the EDL tendon. Indications: headache, red eyes, tinnitus, mastitis.

title: GB43 俠溪（Xiaxi）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第4、5趾間縫紋端（滎穴）。主治：頭痛、眩暈、耳鳴耳聾、目赤、脅痛、熱病。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: Proximal to the web between the 4th and 5th toes (ying-spring). Indications: headache, dizziness, tinnitus, deafness, red eyes.

title: GB44 足竅陰（Zuqiaoyin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足少陽膽經。定位：第4趾外側趾甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：頭痛、目赤、耳聾、咽痛、脅痛、失眠、熱病。
summaryEn: Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang. Location: 0.1 cun from the lateral corner of the 4th toenail (jing-well). Indications: headache, red eyes, deafness, sore throat, insomnia.

title: LR1 大敦（Dadun）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：足大趾外側趾甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）。主治：疝氣、遺尿、崩漏、陰挺、癲癇。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 0.1 cun from the lateral corner of the great toenail (jing-well). Indications: hernia, enuresis, flooding, prolapse, epilepsy.

title: LR2 行間（Xingjian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：第1、2趾間縫紋端（滎穴）。主治：頭痛、目赤、眩暈、脅痛、月經不調、崩漏、遺尿、癲癇、失眠；清肝火。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: Proximal to the web between the 1st and 2nd toes (ying-spring). Indications: headache, red eyes, dizziness, hypochondriac pain, irregular menses, enuresis, insomnia; clears liver fire.

title: LR3 太衝（Taichong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：足背，第1、2蹠骨結合部前方凹陷（輸穴、原穴）。主治：頭痛、眩暈、目赤、口歪、脅痛、月經不調、痛經、遺尿、癲癇、小兒驚風、下肢痿痹；疏肝要穴（四關之一）。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: On the dorsum in the depression distal to the junction of the 1st and 2nd metatarsals (shu-stream, yuan-source). Indications: headache, dizziness, red eyes, facial deviation, hypochondriac pain, dysmenorrhoea, epilepsy, infantile convulsion; the liver-coursing point (one of the four gates).

title: LR4 中封（Zhongfeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：內踝前1寸，脛骨前肌腱內側凹陷（經穴）。主治：疝氣、遺精、小便不利、腹痛、內踝腫痛。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 1 cun anterior to the medial malleolus medial to the tibialis anterior tendon (jing-river). Indications: hernia, emission, dysuria, ankle pain.

title: LR5 蠡溝（Ligou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：內踝尖上5寸，脛骨內側面中央（絡穴）。主治：月經不調、帶下、陰癢、小便不利、疝氣、足脛痠痛。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 5 cun above the medial malleolus at the centre of the medial tibial surface (luo). Indications: irregular menses, discharge, pruritus vulvae, hernia.

title: LR6 中都（Zhongdu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：內踝尖上7寸，脛骨內側面中央（郄穴）。主治：腹痛、泄瀉、疝氣、崩漏、惡露不盡。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 7 cun above the medial malleolus (xi-cleft). Indications: abdominal pain, diarrhoea, hernia, flooding, lochia.

title: LR7 膝關（Xiguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：陰陵泉後1寸。主治：膝髕腫痛、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 1 cun posterior to SP9. Indications: knee pain, leg paralysis.

title: LR8 曲泉（Ququan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：屈膝，膝內側橫紋頭上方凹陷，半膜肌腱前緣（合穴）。主治：月經不調、痛經、帶下、陰挺、疝氣、小便不利、膝痛。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: With the knee flexed, above the medial end of the popliteal crease anterior to the semimembranosus tendon (he-sea). Indications: irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, discharge, prolapse, hernia, knee pain.

title: LR9 陰包（Yinbao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：股骨內上髁上4寸，縫匠肌後緣。主治：月經不調、小便不利、遺尿、腰骶痛。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 4 cun above the medial epicondyle of the femur at the posterior border of the sartorius. Indications: irregular menses, dysuria, enuresis.

title: LR10 足五里（Zuwuli）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：氣衝直下3寸，長收肌外緣。主治：少腹痛、小便不利、陰挺、睪丸腫痛。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 3 cun below ST30 at the lateral border of the adductor longus. Indications: lower abdominal pain, dysuria, prolapse.

title: LR11 陰廉（Yinlian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：氣衝直下2寸。主治：月經不調、帶下、少腹痛、不孕。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 2 cun below ST30. Indications: irregular menses, discharge, infertility.

title: LR12 急脈（Jimai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：恥骨聯合下緣旁2.5寸，腹股溝股動脈搏動處外側。主治：少腹痛、疝氣、陰挺。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: 2.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the symphysis lateral to the femoral artery. Indications: lower abdominal pain, hernia, prolapse.

title: LR13 章門（Zhangmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：第11肋骨游離端下方（脾募穴、臟會）。主治：腹脹、泄瀉、脅痛、痞塊、黃疸。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: Below the free end of the 11th rib (front-mu of the spleen; hui of the zang). Indications: distension, diarrhoea, hypochondriac pain, masses, jaundice.

title: LR14 期門（Qimen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 足厥陰肝經。定位：乳頭直下，第6肋間隙（肝募穴）。主治：胸脅脹痛、嘔吐、吞酸、呃逆、腹脹、乳癰、奔豚。
summaryEn: Liver channel of foot-jueyin. Location: Directly below the nipple in the 6th intercostal space (front-mu of the liver). Indications: chest-hypochondriac pain, vomiting, acid reflux, hiccup, mastitis.

title: GV1 長強（Changqiang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：尾骨端與肛門連線中點（絡穴）。主治：泄瀉、便血、便秘、痔疾、脫肛、癲狂癇、腰脊痛。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Midway between the tip of the coccyx and the anus (luo). Indications: diarrhoea, blood in stool, haemorrhoids, prolapse, epilepsy.

title: GV2 腰俞（Yaoshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：骶管裂孔處。主治：腰脊強痛、月經不調、痔疾、下肢痿痹、癲癇。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: In the sacral hiatus. Indications: back pain, irregular menses, haemorrhoids, epilepsy.

title: GV3 腰陽關（Yaoyangguan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第4腰椎棘突下凹陷。主治：腰骶痛、下肢痿痹、月經不調、遺精、陽痿。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of L4. Indications: lumbosacral pain, leg paralysis, impotence.

title: GV4 命門（Mingmen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第2腰椎棘突下凹陷。主治：腰脊強痛、遺精、陽痿、帶下、月經不調、泄瀉、小便頻數；溫補腎陽。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of L2. Indications: back pain, emission, impotence, discharge, diarrhoea, urinary frequency; warms kidney yang.

title: GV5 懸樞（Xuanshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第1腰椎棘突下凹陷。主治：腰脊強痛、腹脹、泄瀉、脫肛。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of L1. Indications: back pain, distension, diarrhoea, prolapse.

title: GV6 脊中（Jizhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第11胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：腰脊強痛、泄瀉、黃疸、痔疾、癲癇。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T11. Indications: back pain, diarrhoea, jaundice, epilepsy.

title: GV7 中樞（Zhongshu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第10胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：腰背痛、黃疸、嘔吐、腹滿。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T10. Indications: back pain, jaundice, vomiting.

title: GV8 筋縮（Jinsuo）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第9胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：脊強、癲癇、胃痛、筋攣。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T9. Indications: back stiffness, epilepsy, stomach pain, spasm.

title: GV9 至陽（Zhiyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第7胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：黃疸、胸脅脹痛、咳嗽、脊強、胃痛。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T7. Indications: jaundice, chest pain, cough, back stiffness.

title: GV10 靈台（Lingtai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第6胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、疔瘡、脊痛項強。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T6. Indications: cough, asthma, furuncles, back pain.

title: GV11 神道（Shendao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第5胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：心悸、健忘、咳嗽、脊背強痛、癲癇。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T5. Indications: palpitations, forgetfulness, cough, epilepsy.

title: GV12 身柱（Shenzhu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第3胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、癲癇、脊背強痛、疔瘡；小兒保健灸。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T3. Indications: cough, asthma, epilepsy, back pain; paediatric health moxibustion.

title: GV13 陶道（Taodao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第1胸椎棘突下凹陷。主治：熱病、瘧疾、頭痛、脊強、咳嗽。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of T1. Indications: febrile disease, malaria, headache.

title: GV14 大椎（Dazhui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：第7頸椎棘突下凹陷（諸陽之會）。主治：熱病、瘧疾、咳嗽、氣喘、項強、癲癇、感冒、盜汗；退熱要穴。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Below the spinous process of C7 (meeting of all yang). Indications: febrile disease, malaria, cough, asthma, stiff neck, epilepsy, common cold; the fever point.

title: GV15 啞門（Yamen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：後髮際正中直上0.5寸，第2頸椎棘突上際凹陷。主治：暴喑、舌強不語、癲狂癇、頭痛、項強。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 0.5 cun above the posterior hairline midline, above the spinous process of C2. Indications: sudden aphasia, stiff tongue, mania, headache.

title: GV16 風府（Fengfu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：後髮際正中直上1寸，枕外隆凸直下凹陷。主治：頭痛、眩暈、項強、中風、癲狂、咽痛、鼻衄。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 1 cun above the posterior hairline midline directly below the external occipital protuberance. Indications: headache, dizziness, stiff neck, stroke, mania, epistaxis.

title: GV17 腦戶（Naohu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：枕外隆凸上緣凹陷，風府上1.5寸。主治：頭痛、項強、眩暈、癲癇。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: At the upper border of the external occipital protuberance, 1.5 cun above GV16. Indications: headache, stiff neck, epilepsy.

title: GV18 強間（Qiangjian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：後髮際正中直上4寸。主治：頭痛、目眩、項強、癲狂。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 4 cun above the posterior hairline. Indications: headache, dizziness, mania.

title: GV19 後頂（Houding）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：後髮際正中直上5.5寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、癲狂癇。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 5.5 cun above the posterior hairline. Indications: headache, dizziness, epilepsy.

title: GV20 百會（Baihui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：前髮際正中直上5寸，兩耳尖連線中點。主治：頭痛、眩暈、中風、失語、癲狂、失眠、健忘、脫肛、陰挺、泄瀉；升陽舉陷、醒腦。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 5 cun above the anterior hairline at the midpoint of the line connecting the ear apices. Indications: headache, dizziness, stroke, aphasia, mania, insomnia, forgetfulness, rectal/uterine prolapse; raises yang and clears the brain.

title: GV21 前頂（Qianding）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：前髮際正中直上3.5寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、鼻淵、癲癇、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 3.5 cun above the anterior hairline. Indications: headache, dizziness, sinusitis, epilepsy.

title: GV22 囟會（Xinhui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：前髮際正中直上2寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、鼻淵、鼻衄、癲癇、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 2 cun above the anterior hairline. Indications: headache, dizziness, sinusitis, epistaxis.

title: GV23 上星（Shangxing）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：前髮際正中直上1寸。主治：頭痛、目痛、鼻淵、鼻衄、癲狂、熱病。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 1 cun above the anterior hairline. Indications: headache, eye pain, sinusitis, epistaxis.

title: GV24 神庭（Shenting）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：前髮際正中直上0.5寸。主治：頭痛、眩暈、失眠、癲狂癇、鼻淵。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: 0.5 cun above the anterior hairline. Indications: headache, dizziness, insomnia, epilepsy, sinusitis.

title: GV25 素髎（Suliao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：鼻尖正中。主治：鼻塞、鼻衄、鼻淵、昏迷、驚厥、新生兒窒息。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: At the tip of the nose. Indications: nasal obstruction, epistaxis, coma, convulsion, neonatal asphyxia.

title: GV26 水溝（人中）（Shuigou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：人中溝上1/3與下2/3交點。主治：昏迷、暈厥、中暑、癲狂癇、中風、牙關緊閉、口眼歪斜、急性腰扭傷；急救要穴。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: At the junction of the upper and middle thirds of the philtrum. Indications: coma, syncope, heatstroke, epilepsy, stroke, trismus, facial paralysis, acute lumbar sprain; the premier emergency point.

title: GV27 兌端（Duiduan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：上唇尖端，人中溝下端與唇紅交界。主治：昏迷、癲狂、齒齦腫痛、口歪、鼻衄。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: At the tip of the upper lip at the junction of the philtrum and the vermilion. Indications: coma, mania, gum swelling, facial deviation.

title: GV28 齦交（Yinjiao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 督脈。定位：上唇內，唇繫帶與上齒齦連接處。主治：齒齦腫痛、口臭、鼻淵、癲狂、急性腰痛。
summaryEn: Governor vessel (du mai). Location: Inside the upper lip at the junction of the frenulum and the gum. Indications: gum swelling, halitosis, sinusitis, acute low back pain.

title: CV1 會陰（Huiyin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：會陰部，男性陰囊根部與肛門連線中點，女性大陰唇後聯合與肛門連線中點。主治：溺水窒息、昏迷、癲狂、小便不利、遺精、陰痛陰癢。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the perineum, midway between the anus and the scrotum/posterior labial commissure. Indications: drowning, coma, mania, dysuria, emission, genital pain or itch.

title: CV2 曲骨（Qugu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：恥骨聯合上緣中點。主治：小便不利、遺尿、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、帶下。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the midpoint of the upper border of the pubic symphysis. Indications: dysuria, enuresis, emission, impotence, irregular menses.

title: CV3 中極（Zhongji）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍下4寸（膀胱募穴）。主治：小便不利、遺尿、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、痛經、帶下、不孕。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 4 cun below the umbilicus (front-mu of the bladder). Indications: dysuria, enuresis, emission, impotence, irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, infertility.

title: CV4 關元（Guanyuan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍下3寸（小腸募穴）。主治：中風脫證、虛勞、少腹痛、泄瀉、遺尿、小便頻數、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、不孕；培元固本、保健灸。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 3 cun below the umbilicus (front-mu of the small intestine). Indications: collapse, debility, lower abdominal pain, diarrhoea, enuresis, impotence, irregular menses, infertility; the foundational tonifying point.

title: CV5 石門（Shimen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍下2寸（三焦募穴）。主治：腹脹、泄瀉、水腫、小便不利、經閉、崩漏。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 2 cun below the umbilicus (front-mu of the sanjiao). Indications: distension, diarrhoea, oedema, dysuria, amenorrhoea.

title: CV6 氣海（Qihai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍下1.5寸。主治：虛脫、虛勞、腹痛、泄瀉、便秘、遺尿、月經不調、崩漏、疝氣；補氣要穴。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 1.5 cun below the umbilicus. Indications: collapse, debility, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, enuresis, irregular menses, hernia; the qi-tonifying point.

title: CV7 陰交（Yinjiao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍下1寸。主治：腹痛、水腫、疝氣、月經不調、帶下。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 1 cun below the umbilicus. Indications: abdominal pain, oedema, hernia, irregular menses.

title: CV8 神闕（Shenque）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍中央。主治：中風脫證、四肢厥冷、腹痛、泄瀉、脫肛、水腫。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the centre of the umbilicus. Indications: collapse, cold limbs, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, prolapse, oedema.

title: CV9 水分（Shuifen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上1寸。主治：水腫、腹脹、泄瀉、小便不利。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 1 cun above the umbilicus. Indications: oedema, distension, diarrhoea, dysuria.

title: CV10 下脘（Xiawan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上2寸。主治：胃痛、腹脹、嘔吐、泄瀉、痞塊。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 2 cun above the umbilicus. Indications: stomach pain, distension, vomiting, diarrhoea, masses.

title: CV11 建里（Jianli）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上3寸。主治：胃痛、腹脹、嘔吐、食慾不振、水腫。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 3 cun above the umbilicus. Indications: stomach pain, distension, vomiting, poor appetite, oedema.

title: CV12 中脘（Zhongwan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上4寸（胃募穴、腑會）。主治：胃痛、腹脹、嘔吐、吞酸、泄瀉、黃疸、癲狂、失眠；胃病要穴。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 4 cun above the umbilicus (front-mu of the stomach; hui of the fu). Indications: stomach pain, distension, vomiting, acid reflux, diarrhoea, jaundice, insomnia; the stomach point.

title: CV13 上脘（Shangwan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上5寸。主治：胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、癲癇。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 5 cun above the umbilicus. Indications: stomach pain, vomiting, distension, epilepsy.

title: CV14 巨闕（Juque）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：臍上6寸（心募穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、胸痛、嘔吐、癲狂癇、胃痛。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: 6 cun above the umbilicus (front-mu of the heart). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, chest pain, vomiting, mania.

title: CV15 鳩尾（Jiuwei）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：劍突下，臍上7寸（絡穴）。主治：心痛、心悸、胸滿、癲狂癇、嘔吐、呃逆。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: Below the xiphoid, 7 cun above the umbilicus (luo). Indications: heart pain, palpitations, chest fullness, epilepsy, hiccup.

title: CV16 中庭（Zhongting）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：胸劍聯合中點。主治：胸脅脹滿、噎膈、嘔吐、小兒吐乳。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the xiphisternal junction. Indications: chest fullness, dysphagia, vomiting.

title: CV17 膻中（Danzhong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：前正中線，平第4肋間隙，兩乳頭連線中點（心包募穴、氣會）。主治：胸悶、胸痛、心悸、氣喘、咳嗽、噎膈、乳少、乳癰、呃逆；理氣要穴。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: On the anterior midline level with the 4th intercostal space, midway between the nipples (front-mu of the pericardium; hui of qi). Indications: chest oppression, chest pain, palpitations, asthma, cough, dysphagia, insufficient lactation, mastitis, hiccup; the qi-regulating point.

title: CV18 玉堂（Yutang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：前正中線，平第3肋間隙。主治：胸痛、咳嗽、氣喘、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: On the midline level with the 3rd intercostal space. Indications: chest pain, cough, asthma.

title: CV19 紫宮（Zigong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：前正中線，平第2肋間隙。主治：胸痛、咳嗽、氣喘。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: Level with the 2nd intercostal space. Indications: chest pain, cough, asthma.

title: CV20 華蓋（Huagai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：前正中線，平第1肋間隙。主治：胸痛、咳嗽、氣喘。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: Level with the 1st intercostal space. Indications: chest pain, cough, asthma.

title: CV21 璇璣（Xuanji）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：胸骨柄中央，天突下1寸。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、咽痛、食積。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the centre of the manubrium, 1 cun below CV22. Indications: cough, asthma, chest pain, sore throat.

title: CV22 天突（Tiantu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：胸骨上窩中央。主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、咽喉腫痛、暴喑、噎膈、癭氣。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the centre of the suprasternal fossa. Indications: cough, asthma, chest pain, sore throat, hoarseness, dysphagia, goitre.

title: CV23 廉泉（Lianquan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：喉結上方，舌骨上緣凹陷處。主治：舌強不語、舌下腫痛、流涎、暴喑、吞嚥困難。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: Above the laryngeal prominence at the upper border of the hyoid. Indications: stiff tongue, sublingual swelling, drooling, aphasia, dysphagia.

title: CV24 承漿（Chengjiang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 任脈。定位：頦唇溝正中凹陷處。主治：口眼歪斜、流涎、齒齦腫痛、暴喑、癲狂。
summaryEn: Conception vessel (ren mai). Location: At the centre of the mentolabial groove. Indications: facial paralysis, drooling, gum swelling, mania.

title: EX-HN1 四神聰（Sishencong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：百會前後左右各1寸，共4穴。主治：頭痛、眩暈、失眠、健忘、癲癇。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Four points 1 cun anterior, posterior and lateral to GV20. Indications: headache, dizziness, insomnia, forgetfulness, epilepsy.

title: EX-HN3 印堂（Yintang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：兩眉頭連線中點。主治：頭痛、眩暈、鼻淵、鼻衄、失眠、小兒驚風。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Midway between the medial ends of the eyebrows. Indications: headache, dizziness, sinusitis, epistaxis, insomnia.

title: EX-HN4 魚腰（Yuyao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：瞳孔直上，眉毛中點。主治：眉棱骨痛、眼瞼下垂、目赤、口眼歪斜。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Directly above the pupil at the midpoint of the eyebrow. Indications: brow pain, ptosis, red eyes.

title: EX-HN5 太陽（Taiyang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：眉梢與目外眥之間向後約1橫指凹陷處。主治：頭痛、偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、口眼歪斜、齒痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: About one finger-breadth posterior to the midpoint between the lateral end of the eyebrow and the outer canthus. Indications: headache, migraine, red eyes, facial paralysis, toothache.

title: EX-HN6 耳尖（Erjian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：折耳向前，耳廓上方尖端。主治：目赤腫痛、咽喉腫痛、高熱、麥粒腫。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the apex of the auricle when folded forward. Indications: red eyes, sore throat, high fever, stye.

title: EX-HN7 球後（Qiuhou）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：眶下緣外1/4與內3/4交界處。主治：目疾（視神經萎縮、視網膜病變）。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the junction of the lateral quarter and medial three quarters of the infraorbital margin. Indications: eye disorders (optic atrophy, retinopathy).

title: EX-HN8 上迎香（Shangyingxiang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：鼻翼軟骨與鼻甲交界，鼻唇溝上端。主治：鼻塞、鼻淵、鼻衄、目赤。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the junction of the alar cartilage and the nasal concha at the upper end of the nasolabial groove. Indications: nasal obstruction, sinusitis.

title: EX-HN12 金津（左）／玉液（右）（Jinjin/Yuye）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：舌下繫帶兩側靜脈上，左金津右玉液。主治：舌強、舌腫、嘔吐、消渴、失語。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the sublingual veins either side of the frenulum. Indications: stiff tongue, tongue swelling, vomiting, diabetes, aphasia.

title: EX-HN14 翳明（Yiming）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：翳風後1寸。主治：目疾、耳鳴、失眠、頭痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 1 cun posterior to TE17. Indications: eye disorders, tinnitus, insomnia.

title: EX-HN15 頸百勞（Jingbailao）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：大椎直上2寸，旁開1寸。主治：項強、咳嗽、氣喘、骨蒸潮熱、盜汗。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 2 cun above GV14, 1 cun lateral. Indications: stiff neck, cough, asthma, night sweats.

title: EX-HN16 安眠（Anmian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：翳風與風池連線中點。主治：失眠、頭痛、眩暈、心悸、癲狂。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Midway between TE17 and GB20. Indications: insomnia, headache, dizziness, palpitations.

title: EX-HN17 牽正（Qianzheng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：耳垂前0.5–1寸。主治：口眼歪斜、口瘡。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 0.5–1 cun anterior to the earlobe. Indications: facial paralysis, mouth ulcers.

title: EX-CA1 子宮（Zigong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：中極旁開3寸。主治：陰挺、月經不調、痛經、崩漏、不孕。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 3 cun lateral to CV3. Indications: prolapse, irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, infertility.

title: EX-B1 定喘（Dingchuan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：大椎旁開0.5寸。主治：哮喘、咳嗽、項強、肩背痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 0.5 cun lateral to GV14. Indications: asthma, cough, stiff neck.

title: EX-B2 夾脊（Jiaji）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第1胸椎至第5腰椎各棘突下旁開0.5寸，共34穴。主治：相應節段的臟腑與肢體病症。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 0.5 cun lateral to the lower border of each spinous process from T1 to L5 (34 points). Indications: disorders of the organs and limbs corresponding to each segment.

title: EX-B3 胃脘下俞（Weiwanxiashu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第8胸椎棘突下旁開1.5寸。主治：消渴、胃痛、嘔吐、胸脅痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 1.5 cun lateral to T8. Indications: diabetes, stomach pain, vomiting.

title: EX-B4 痞根（Pigen）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第1腰椎棘突下旁開3.5寸。主治：痞塊、腰痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 3.5 cun lateral to L1. Indications: abdominal masses, low back pain.

title: EX-B7 腰眼（Yaoyan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第4腰椎棘突下旁開約3.5寸凹陷。主治：腰痛、月經不調、帶下。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: About 3.5 cun lateral to L4 in the depression. Indications: low back pain, irregular menses.

title: EX-B8 十七椎（Shiqizhui）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第5腰椎棘突下。主治：腰骶痛、痛經、下肢癱瘓。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Below the spinous process of L5. Indications: lumbosacral pain, dysmenorrhoea, paralysis.

title: EX-UE1 肘尖（Zhoujian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：尺骨鷹嘴尖端。主治：瘰癧、癰疽。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the tip of the olecranon. Indications: scrofula, abscesses.

title: EX-UE2 二白（Erbai）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：腕橫紋上4寸，橈側腕屈肌腱兩側各1穴。主治：痔瘡、脫肛、前臂痛。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 4 cun above the wrist crease, one point either side of the FCR tendon. Indications: haemorrhoids, prolapse.

title: EX-UE7 腰痛點（Yaotongdian）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：手背，第2、3與第4、5掌骨間，腕橫紋與掌指關節連線中點，共2穴。主治：急性腰扭傷。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the dorsum between the 2nd–3rd and 4th–5th metacarpals midway between the wrist crease and the MCP joints. Indications: acute lumbar sprain.

title: EX-UE8 外勞宮（落枕）（Wailaogong）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：手背，第2、3掌骨間，掌指關節後0.5寸。主治：落枕、手背腫痛、小兒臍風。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the dorsum between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, 0.5 cun proximal to the MCP joints. Indications: stiff neck, hand swelling.

title: EX-UE9 八邪（Baxie）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：手背，五指間指蹼緣後方赤白肉際，共8穴。主治：手指麻木、手背腫痛、煩熱、毒蛇咬傷。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the dorsum at the web margins between the fingers (8 points). Indications: finger numbness, hand swelling, snakebite.

title: EX-UE10 四縫（Sifeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第2至5指掌面近端指間關節橫紋中點。主治：小兒疳積、百日咳。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the palmar aspect at the midpoints of the PIP joint creases of the 2nd–5th fingers. Indications: infantile malnutrition, whooping cough.

title: EX-UE11 十宣（Shixuan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：十指尖端，距指甲游離緣0.1寸。主治：昏迷、中暑、癲癇、高熱、咽痛、手指麻木。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the tips of the ten fingers, 0.1 cun from the nails. Indications: coma, heatstroke, epilepsy, high fever, finger numbness.

title: EX-LE1 髖骨（Kuangu）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：梁丘兩側各1.5寸，共2穴。主治：膝痛、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 1.5 cun either side of ST34. Indications: knee pain, leg paralysis.

title: EX-LE2 鶴頂（Heding）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：髕底中點上方凹陷。主治：膝痛、足脛無力、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: In the depression above the midpoint of the patellar base. Indications: knee pain, leg weakness.

title: EX-LE3 百蟲窩（Baichongwo）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：血海上1寸。主治：皮膚瘙癢、風疹、濕疹、蛔蟲病。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 1 cun above SP10. Indications: itching, urticaria, eczema.

title: EX-LE4 內膝眼（Neixiyan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：髕韌帶內側凹陷處。主治：膝痛、下肢無力。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: Medial to the patellar ligament. Indications: knee pain, leg weakness.

title: EX-LE6 膽囊（Dannang）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：陽陵泉直下2寸。主治：急慢性膽囊炎、膽石症、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 2 cun directly below GB34. Indications: cholecystitis, gallstones.

title: EX-LE7 闌尾（Lanwei）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：足三里下2寸。主治：急慢性闌尾炎、消化不良、下肢痿痹。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: 2 cun below ST36. Indications: appendicitis, indigestion.

title: EX-LE10 八風（Bafeng）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：足背，五趾間趾蹼緣後方赤白肉際，共8穴。主治：足背腫痛、趾痛、毒蛇咬傷、腳氣。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the dorsum at the web margins between the toes (8 points). Indications: foot swelling, toe pain, snakebite.

title: EX-LE11 獨陰（Duyin）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：第2趾掌面遠端趾間關節橫紋中點。主治：胞衣不下、月經不調、疝氣、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: On the plantar aspect at the midpoint of the DIP crease of the 2nd toe. Indications: retained placenta, irregular menses, hernia.

title: EX-LE12 氣端（Qiduan）
departmentTitle: 十四經穴與奇穴（361 + 奇穴）
departmentTitleEn: The 361 classical acupoints and extra points
summary: 經外奇穴。定位：十趾尖端，距趾甲游離緣0.1寸。主治：足趾麻木、足背腫痛、中風急救。
summaryEn: Extra points. Location: At the tips of the ten toes. Indications: toe numbness, foot swelling, stroke emergency.

title: 麻黃（Mahuang）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛微苦溫，歸肺、膀胱經。發汗解表、宣肺平喘、利水消腫。常用量 2–9 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛微苦溫; channels: 肺、膀胱. releases the exterior by sweating, diffuses the lung to calm wheezing, promotes urination. Usual dose 2–9 g.

title: 桂枝（Guizhi）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛甘溫，歸心、肺、膀胱經。發汗解肌、溫通經脈、助陽化氣。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛甘溫; channels: 心、肺、膀胱. releases the muscle layer, warms and frees the channels, assists yang qi transformation. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 紫蘇葉（Zisuye）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛溫，歸肺、脾經。解表散寒、行氣寬中、解魚蟹毒。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛溫; channels: 肺、脾. releases the exterior, moves qi, resolves fish/crab toxin. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 生薑（Shengjiang）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛微溫，歸肺、脾、胃經。解表散寒、溫中止嘔、化痰止咳。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛微溫; channels: 肺、脾、胃. releases the exterior, warms the middle, stops vomiting. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 荊芥（Jingjie）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛微溫，歸肺、肝經。祛風解表、透疹消瘡、止血（炒炭）。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛微溫; channels: 肺、肝. dispels wind, releases the exterior, outthrusts rashes; charred stops bleeding. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 防風（Fangfeng）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛甘微溫，歸膀胱、肝、脾經。祛風解表、勝濕止痛、止痙。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛甘微溫; channels: 膀胱、肝、脾. dispels wind, overcomes dampness, relieves pain and spasm. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 羌活（Qianghuo）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛苦溫，歸膀胱、腎經。解表散寒、祛風勝濕、止痛（上半身）。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛苦溫; channels: 膀胱、腎. releases the exterior, dispels wind-damp, relieves pain of the upper body. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 白芷（Baizhi）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛溫，歸肺、胃經。解表散寒、祛風止痛、通鼻竅、燥濕止帶、消腫排膿。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛溫; channels: 肺、胃. releases the exterior, relieves pain (yangming headache), opens the nose, dries damp. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 細辛（Xixin）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛溫（有小毒），歸肺、腎、心經。解表散寒、祛風止痛、通竅、溫肺化飲。常用量 1–3 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛溫（有小毒）; channels: 肺、腎、心. releases the exterior, relieves pain, opens orifices, warms the lung to transform rheum. Usual dose 1–3 g.

title: 藁本（Gaoben）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛溫，歸膀胱經。祛風散寒、除濕止痛（巔頂痛）。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛溫; channels: 膀胱. dispels wind-cold, relieves vertex headache. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 蒼耳子（Cangerzi）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛苦溫（有毒），歸肺經。散風寒、通鼻竅、祛風濕。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛苦溫（有毒）; channels: 肺. dispels wind-cold, opens the nose, dispels wind-damp. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 辛夷（Xinyi）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛溫，歸肺、胃經。散風寒、通鼻竅。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛溫; channels: 肺、胃. dispels wind-cold, opens the nasal orifices. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 香薷（Xiangru）
summary: 解表藥：辛溫解表。辛微溫，歸肺、脾、胃經。發汗解表、化濕和中、利水消腫（夏月麻黃）。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: warm-acrid. 辛微溫; channels: 肺、脾、胃. releases the exterior, transforms damp, promotes urination (summer ephedra). Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 薄荷（Bohe）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。辛涼，歸肺、肝經。疏散風熱、清利頭目、利咽透疹、疏肝行氣。常用量 3–6 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 辛涼; channels: 肺、肝. disperses wind-heat, clears the head and eyes, benefits the throat, courses the liver. Usual dose 3–6 g.

title: 牛蒡子（Niubangzi）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。辛苦寒，歸肺、胃經。疏散風熱、宣肺透疹、解毒利咽。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 辛苦寒; channels: 肺、胃. disperses wind-heat, outthrusts rashes, resolves toxin, benefits the throat. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 蟬蛻（Chantui）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。甘寒，歸肺、肝經。疏散風熱、利咽開音、透疹、明目退翳、息風止痙。常用量 3–6 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 甘寒; channels: 肺、肝. disperses wind-heat, opens the voice, outthrusts rashes, brightens the eyes, extinguishes wind. Usual dose 3–6 g.

title: 桑葉（Sangye）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。甘苦寒，歸肺、肝經。疏散風熱、清肺潤燥、清肝明目。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 甘苦寒; channels: 肺、肝. disperses wind-heat, clears and moistens the lung, clears the liver and brightens the eyes. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 菊花（Juhua）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。甘苦微寒，歸肺、肝經。疏散風熱、平肝明目、清熱解毒。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 甘苦微寒; channels: 肺、肝. disperses wind-heat, calms the liver, brightens the eyes, resolves toxin. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 柴胡（Chaihu）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。辛苦微寒，歸肝、膽、肺經。解表退熱、疏肝解鬱、升舉陽氣。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 辛苦微寒; channels: 肝、膽、肺. releases the exterior and reduces fever, courses the liver, raises yang qi. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 升麻（Shengma）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。辛微甘微寒，歸肺、脾、胃、大腸經。發表透疹、清熱解毒、升舉陽氣。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 辛微甘微寒; channels: 肺、脾、胃、大腸. outthrusts rashes, resolves toxin, raises yang. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 葛根（Gegen）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。甘辛涼，歸脾、胃經。解肌退熱、透疹、生津止渴、升陽止瀉（項背強痛）。常用量 10–15 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 甘辛涼; channels: 脾、胃. releases the muscles and reduces fever, generates fluids, raises yang to stop diarrhoea; neck stiffness. Usual dose 10–15 g.

title: 淡豆豉（Dandouchi）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。苦辛涼，歸肺、胃經。解表、除煩、宣發鬱熱。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 苦辛涼; channels: 肺、胃. releases the exterior, eliminates vexation. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 蔓荊子（Manjingzi）
summary: 解表藥：辛涼解表。辛苦微寒，歸膀胱、肝、胃經。疏散風熱、清利頭目。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing: cool-acrid. 辛苦微寒; channels: 膀胱、肝、胃. disperses wind-heat, clears the head and eyes. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 石膏（Shigao）
summary: 清熱藥。辛甘大寒，歸肺、胃經。清熱瀉火、除煩止渴（氣分大熱）；煅用收濕斂瘡。常用量 15–60 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 辛甘大寒; channels: 肺、胃. clears heat and drains fire, relieves thirst (qi-level heat); calcined for sores. Usual dose 15–60 g.

title: 知母（Zhimu）
summary: 清熱藥。苦甘寒，歸肺、胃、腎經。清熱瀉火、滋陰潤燥。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦甘寒; channels: 肺、胃、腎. clears heat, drains fire, enriches yin, moistens dryness. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 梔子（Zhizi）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸心、肺、三焦經。瀉火除煩、清熱利濕、涼血解毒。常用量 6–10 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 心、肺、三焦. drains fire, eliminates vexation, clears damp-heat, cools blood. Usual dose 6–10 g.

title: 夏枯草（Xiakucao）
summary: 清熱藥。辛苦寒，歸肝、膽經。清肝瀉火、明目、散結消腫。常用量 10–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 辛苦寒; channels: 肝、膽. clears liver fire, brightens eyes, dissipates nodules. Usual dose 10–15 g.

title: 蘆根（Lugen）
summary: 清熱藥。甘寒，歸肺、胃經。清熱生津、除煩止嘔、利尿。常用量 15–30 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 甘寒; channels: 肺、胃. clears heat, generates fluids, stops vomiting, promotes urination. Usual dose 15–30 g.

title: 天花粉（Tianhuafen）
summary: 清熱藥。甘微苦微寒，歸肺、胃經。清熱生津、消腫排膿。常用量 10–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 甘微苦微寒; channels: 肺、胃. clears heat, generates fluids, reduces swelling and expels pus. Usual dose 10–15 g.

title: 淡竹葉（Danzhuye）
summary: 清熱藥。甘淡寒，歸心、胃、小腸經。清熱除煩、利尿。常用量 6–10 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 甘淡寒; channels: 心、胃、小腸. clears heat, eliminates vexation, promotes urination. Usual dose 6–10 g.

title: 決明子（Juemingzi）
summary: 清熱藥。甘苦鹹微寒，歸肝、大腸經。清肝明目、潤腸通便。常用量 10–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 甘苦鹹微寒; channels: 肝、大腸. clears the liver, brightens eyes, moistens the intestines. Usual dose 10–15 g.

title: 黃芩（Huangqin）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸肺、膽、脾、大腸、小腸經。清熱燥濕、瀉火解毒、止血、安胎（上焦濕熱）。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 肺、膽、脾、大腸、小腸. clears heat, dries damp, drains fire, stops bleeding, calms the fetus (upper burner). Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 黃連（Huanglian）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸心、脾、胃、肝、膽、大腸經。清熱燥濕、瀉火解毒（中焦濕熱、心火）。常用量 2–5 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 心、脾、胃、肝、膽、大腸. clears heat, dries damp, drains fire, resolves toxin (middle burner, heart fire). Usual dose 2–5 g.

title: 黃柏（Huangbai）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸腎、膀胱、大腸經。清熱燥濕、瀉火除蒸、解毒療瘡（下焦濕熱）。常用量 3–12 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 腎、膀胱、大腸. clears heat, dries damp, drains deficiency fire (lower burner). Usual dose 3–12 g.

title: 龍膽（Longdan）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸肝、膽經。清熱燥濕、瀉肝膽火。常用量 3–6 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 肝、膽. clears damp-heat, drains liver–gallbladder fire. Usual dose 3–6 g.

title: 苦參（Kushen）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸心、肝、胃、大腸、膀胱經。清熱燥濕、殺蟲、利尿。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 心、肝、胃、大腸、膀胱. clears damp-heat, kills parasites, promotes urination. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 金銀花（Jinyinhua）
summary: 清熱藥。甘寒，歸肺、心、胃經。清熱解毒、疏散風熱。常用量 6–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 甘寒; channels: 肺、心、胃. clears heat, resolves toxin, disperses wind-heat. Usual dose 6–15 g.

title: 連翹（Lianqiao）
summary: 清熱藥。苦微寒，歸肺、心、小腸經。清熱解毒、消腫散結、疏散風熱（瘡家聖藥）。常用量 6–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦微寒; channels: 肺、心、小腸. clears heat, resolves toxin, dissipates nodules (the sage of sores). Usual dose 6–15 g.

title: 蒲公英（Pugongying）
summary: 清熱藥。苦甘寒，歸肝、胃經。清熱解毒、消腫散結、利濕通淋（乳癰要藥）。常用量 10–30 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦甘寒; channels: 肝、胃. clears heat, resolves toxin, dissipates swelling (mastitis). Usual dose 10–30 g.

title: 紫花地丁（Zihuadiding）
summary: 清熱藥。苦辛寒，歸心、肝經。清熱解毒、涼血消腫（疔瘡）。常用量 15–30 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦辛寒; channels: 心、肝. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, reduces swelling. Usual dose 15–30 g.

title: 板藍根（Banlangen）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸心、胃經。清熱解毒、涼血利咽。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 心、胃. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, benefits the throat. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 大青葉（Daqingye）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸心、胃經。清熱解毒、涼血消斑。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 心、胃. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, resolves maculae. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 魚腥草（Yuxingcao）
summary: 清熱藥。辛微寒，歸肺經。清熱解毒、消癰排膿、利尿通淋（肺癰）。常用量 15–30 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 辛微寒; channels: 肺. clears heat-toxin, expels pus (lung abscess), promotes urination. Usual dose 15–30 g.

title: 射干（Shegan）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸肺經。清熱解毒、消痰利咽。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 肺. clears heat-toxin, transforms phlegm, benefits the throat. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 白頭翁（Baitouweng）
summary: 清熱藥。苦寒，歸胃、大腸經。清熱解毒、涼血止痢。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 苦寒; channels: 胃、大腸. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, stops dysentery. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 馬齒莧（Machixian）
summary: 清熱藥。酸寒，歸肝、大腸經。清熱解毒、涼血止血、止痢。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing. 酸寒; channels: 肝、大腸. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, stops dysentery. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 生地黃（Shengdihuang）

summaryEn: Spirit-calming. 鹹微寒; channels: 肝、膽、腎. settles the spirit, subdues yang, softens hardness, astringes. Usual dose 9–30 g.

title: 酸棗仁（Suanzaoren）

summaryEn: Spirit-calming. 甘酸平; channels: 肝、膽、心. nourishes the heart and liver, quiets the spirit, constrains sweat. Usual dose 10–15 g.

title: 柏子仁（Baiziren）

summaryEn: Spirit-calming. 甘平; channels: 心、腎、大腸. nourishes the heart, quiets the spirit, moistens the intestines. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 遠志（Yuanzhi）

summaryEn: Spirit-calming. 苦辛溫; channels: 心、腎、肺. quiets the spirit, boosts intelligence, expels phlegm, opens orifices. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 合歡皮（Hehuanpi）

summaryEn: Spirit-calming. 甘平; channels: 心、肝、肺. resolves constraint, quiets the spirit, quickens blood. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 夜交藤（Yejiaoteng）

title: 玉竹（Yuzhu）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘微寒，歸肺、胃經。養陰潤燥、生津止渴。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘微寒; channels: 肺、胃. nourishes yin, moistens dryness, relieves thirst. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 黃精（Huangjing）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘平，歸脾、肺、腎經。補氣養陰、健脾、潤肺、益腎。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘平; channels: 脾、肺、腎. supplements qi and yin, fortifies spleen, lung and kidney. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 百合（Baihe）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘寒，歸心、肺經。養陰潤肺、清心安神。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘寒; channels: 心、肺. nourishes yin, moistens the lung, clears the heart, quiets the spirit. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 女貞子（Nüzhenzi）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘苦涼，歸肝、腎經。滋補肝腎、明目烏髮。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘苦涼; channels: 肝、腎. enriches liver and kidney, brightens eyes, blackens hair. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 墨旱蓮（Mohanlian）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘酸寒，歸肝、腎經。滋補肝腎、涼血止血。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘酸寒; channels: 肝、腎. enriches liver and kidney, cools blood, stops bleeding. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 龜甲（Guijia）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。鹹甘微寒，歸肝、腎、心經。滋陰潛陽、益腎強骨、養血補心。常用量 9–24 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 鹹甘微寒; channels: 肝、腎、心. enriches yin, subdues yang, strengthens bones, nourishes the heart. Usual dose 9–24 g.

title: 鱉甲（Biejia）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。鹹微寒，歸肝、腎經。滋陰潛陽、退熱除蒸、軟堅散結。常用量 9–24 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 鹹微寒; channels: 肝、腎. enriches yin, subdues yang, relieves steaming fever, softens hardness. Usual dose 9–24 g.

title: 桑椹（Sangshen）
summary: 補虛藥：補陰。甘酸寒，歸心、肝、腎經。滋陰補血、生津潤燥。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Tonifying: yin. 甘酸寒; channels: 心、肝、腎. enriches yin, nourishes blood, generates fluids. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 五味子（Wuweizi）
summary: 收澀藥。酸甘溫，歸肺、心、腎經。收斂固澀、益氣生津、補腎寧心。常用量 2–6 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 酸甘溫; channels: 肺、心、腎. astringes, boosts qi, generates fluids, tonifies the kidney, quiets the heart. Usual dose 2–6 g.

title: 烏梅（Wumei）
summary: 收澀藥。酸澀平，歸肝、脾、肺、大腸經。斂肺止咳、澀腸止瀉、生津止渴、安蛔。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 酸澀平; channels: 肝、脾、肺、大腸. astringes the lung and intestines, generates fluids, calms roundworms. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 山茱萸（Shanzhuyu）
summary: 收澀藥。酸澀微溫，歸肝、腎經。補益肝腎、收斂固澀。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 酸澀微溫; channels: 肝、腎. tonifies liver–kidney, astringes and secures. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 浮小麥（Fuxiaomai）
summary: 收澀藥。甘涼，歸心經。固表止汗、益氣除熱。常用量 15–30 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘涼; channels: 心. secures the exterior, stops sweating. Usual dose 15–30 g.

title: 麻黃根（Mahuanggen）
summary: 收澀藥。甘澀平，歸心、肺經。固表止汗。常用量 3–9 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘澀平; channels: 心、肺. secures the exterior, stops sweating. Usual dose 3–9 g.

title: 訶子（Hezi）
summary: 收澀藥。苦酸澀平，歸肺、大腸經。澀腸止瀉、斂肺止咳、利咽開音。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 苦酸澀平; channels: 肺、大腸. astringes the intestines, constrains the lung, benefits the throat. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 肉豆蔻（Roudoukou）
summary: 收澀藥。辛溫，歸脾、胃、大腸經。溫中行氣、澀腸止瀉。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 辛溫; channels: 脾、胃、大腸. warms the middle, moves qi, astringes the intestines. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 赤石脂（Chishizhi）
summary: 收澀藥。甘酸澀溫，歸大腸、胃經。澀腸止瀉、止血、生肌斂瘡。常用量 9–12 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘酸澀溫; channels: 大腸、胃. astringes the intestines, stops bleeding, generates flesh. Usual dose 9–12 g.

title: 芡實（Qianshi）
summary: 收澀藥。甘澀平，歸脾、腎經。益腎固精、健脾止瀉、除濕止帶。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘澀平; channels: 脾、腎. secures essence, fortifies the spleen, stops discharge. Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 蓮子（Lianzi）
summary: 收澀藥。甘澀平，歸脾、腎、心經。補脾止瀉、益腎澀精、養心安神。常用量 6–15 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘澀平; channels: 脾、腎、心. tonifies the spleen, secures essence, quiets the heart. Usual dose 6–15 g.

title: 金櫻子（Jinyingzi）
summary: 收澀藥。酸甘澀平，歸腎、膀胱、大腸經。固精縮尿、澀腸止瀉。常用量 6–12 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 酸甘澀平; channels: 腎、膀胱、大腸. secures essence, reduces urination, astringes the intestines. Usual dose 6–12 g.

title: 桑螵蛸（Sangpiaoxiao）
summary: 收澀藥。甘鹹平，歸肝、腎經。固精縮尿、補腎助陽。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 甘鹹平; channels: 肝、腎. secures essence, reduces urination, tonifies the kidney. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 海螵蛸（Haipiaoxiao）
summary: 收澀藥。鹹澀溫，歸脾、腎經。收斂止血、澀精止帶、制酸止痛、收濕斂瘡。常用量 5–10 g。
summaryEn: Astringent. 鹹澀溫; channels: 脾、腎. stops bleeding, secures essence, neutralises acid, dries sores. Usual dose 5–10 g.

title: 雄黃（Xionghuang）
summary: 外用與其他。辛溫（有毒），歸肝、大腸經。解毒殺蟲、燥濕祛痰、截瘧（外用為主）。常用量 0.05–0.1（入丸散） g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 辛溫（有毒）; channels: 肝、大腸. resolves toxin, kills parasites (mainly external). Usual dose 0.05–0.1（入丸散） g.

title: 硫黃（Liuhuang）
summary: 外用與其他。酸溫（有毒），歸腎、大腸經。外用解毒殺蟲療瘡；內服補火助陽通便。常用量 1.5–3（製） g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 酸溫（有毒）; channels: 腎、大腸. external: kills parasites; internal: supplements fire. Usual dose 1.5–3（製） g.

title: 爐甘石（Luganshi）
summary: 外用與其他。甘平，歸肝、脾經。解毒明目退翳、收濕止癢斂瘡。常用量 外用 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘平; channels: 肝、脾. resolves toxin, brightens eyes, dries damp, stops itching. Usual dose 外用 g.

title: 硼砂（Pengsha）
summary: 外用與其他。甘鹹涼，歸肺、胃經。外用清熱解毒；內服清肺化痰（口瘡、咽痛）。常用量 外用 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘鹹涼; channels: 肺、胃. external: clears heat-toxin (mouth ulcers). Usual dose 外用 g.

title: 冰片薄荷油（Bingpian Bohe You）
summary: 外用與其他。辛涼，歸肺、肝經。外用清涼止痛止癢（白花油類）。常用量 外用 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 辛涼; channels: 肺、肝. external cooling analgesic (medicated oils). Usual dose 外用 g.

title: 青黛（Qingdai）
summary: 外用與其他。鹹寒，歸肝、肺經。清熱解毒、涼血消斑、瀉火定驚（銀屑病外用）。常用量 1–3（沖服）／外用 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 鹹寒; channels: 肝、肺. clears heat-toxin, cools blood, resolves maculae (psoriasis). Usual dose 1–3（沖服）／外用 g.

title: 蛇床子（Shechuangzi）
summary: 外用與其他。辛苦溫（小毒），歸腎經。外用燥濕殺蟲止癢；內服溫腎壯陽。常用量 3–10／外用 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 辛苦溫（小毒）; channels: 腎. external: dries damp, kills parasites, stops itching; internal: warms the kidney. Usual dose 3–10／外用 g.

title: 大蒜（Dasuan）
summary: 外用與其他。辛溫，歸脾、胃、肺經。解毒消腫、殺蟲、止痢（隔蒜灸）。常用量 9–15 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 辛溫; channels: 脾、胃、肺. resolves toxin, kills parasites, stops dysentery (garlic moxibustion). Usual dose 9–15 g.

title: 蜂房（Fengfang）
summary: 外用與其他。甘平（有毒），歸胃經。攻毒殺蟲、祛風止痛。常用量 3–5 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘平（有毒）; channels: 胃. attacks toxin, kills parasites, dispels wind. Usual dose 3–5 g.

title: 血竭（Xuejie）
summary: 外用與其他。甘鹹平，歸心、肝經。活血定痛、化瘀止血、生肌斂瘡。常用量 1–2（研末） g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘鹹平; channels: 心、肝. quickens blood, relieves pain, stops bleeding, generates flesh. Usual dose 1–2（研末） g.

title: 馬錢子（Maqianzi）
summary: 外用與其他。苦溫（大毒），歸肝、脾經。通絡止痛、散結消腫。常用量 0.3–0.6（炮製入丸散） g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 苦溫（大毒）; channels: 肝、脾. frees the collaterals, relieves pain. Usual dose 0.3–0.6（炮製入丸散） g.

title: 常山（Changshan）
summary: 外用與其他。苦辛寒（有毒），歸肺、肝、心經。湧吐痰涎、截瘧。常用量 5–9 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 苦辛寒（有毒）; channels: 肺、肝、心. induces vomiting of phlegm, interrupts malaria. Usual dose 5–9 g.

title: 瓜蒂（Guadi）
summary: 外用與其他。苦寒（有毒），歸胃經。湧吐痰食、祛濕退黃。常用量 2.5–5 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 苦寒（有毒）; channels: 胃. induces vomiting, relieves jaundice. Usual dose 2.5–5 g.

title: 使君子（Shijunzi）
summary: 外用與其他。甘溫，歸脾、胃經。殺蟲消積（蛔蟲）。常用量 9–12 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘溫; channels: 脾、胃. kills roundworms, disperses accumulation. Usual dose 9–12 g.

title: 檳榔（Binglang）
summary: 外用與其他。苦辛溫，歸胃、大腸經。殺蟲、消積、行氣、利水、截瘧。常用量 3–10 g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 苦辛溫; channels: 胃、大腸. kills parasites, disperses accumulation, moves qi. Usual dose 3–10 g.

title: 南瓜子（Nanguazi）
summary: 外用與其他。甘平，歸胃、大腸經。殺蟲（絛蟲）。常用量 60–120（研粉） g。
summaryEn: External use and others. 甘平; channels: 胃、大腸. kills tapeworms. Usual dose 60–120（研粉） g.

title: 麻黃湯（Mahuang Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：麻黃、桂枝、杏仁、炙甘草。發汗解表、宣肺平喘；主治外感風寒表實證：惡寒發熱、無汗、頭身痛、喘、脈浮緊。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 麻黃、桂枝、杏仁、炙甘草. induces sweating, releases the exterior, diffuses the lung; for wind-cold exterior excess: chills, fever, no sweating, body aches, wheezing, floating-tight pulse.

title: 桂枝湯（Guizhi Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：桂枝、芍藥、炙甘草、生薑、大棗。解肌發表、調和營衛；主治外感風寒表虛證：發熱、汗出、惡風、脈浮緩。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 桂枝、芍藥、炙甘草、生薑、大棗. releases the muscle layer, harmonises ying and wei; for wind-cold exterior deficiency: fever, sweating, aversion to wind, floating-moderate pulse.

title: 九味羌活湯（Jiuwei Qianghuo Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《此事難知》。組成：羌活、防風、蒼朮、細辛、川芎、白芷、生地、黃芩、甘草。發汗祛濕、兼清裡熱；主治外感風寒濕邪兼有裡熱。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《此事難知》. Composition: 羌活、防風、蒼朮、細辛、川芎、白芷、生地、黃芩、甘草. sweats, dispels damp, clears interior heat; for wind-cold-damp with interior heat.

title: 小青龍湯（Xiao Qinglong Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：麻黃、桂枝、芍藥、乾薑、細辛、半夏、五味子、炙甘草。解表散寒、溫肺化飲；主治外寒內飲：惡寒發熱、咳喘痰多清稀。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 麻黃、桂枝、芍藥、乾薑、細辛、半夏、五味子、炙甘草. releases the exterior, warms the lung, transforms rheum; for exterior cold with internal rheum: chills, cough with copious thin sputum.

title: 銀翹散（Yinqiao San）
summary: 解表劑。出自《溫病條辨》。組成：金銀花、連翹、薄荷、荊芥、淡豆豉、牛蒡子、桔梗、竹葉、蘆根、甘草。辛涼透表、清熱解毒；主治溫病初起、風熱表證：發熱微惡寒、咽痛、口渴、脈浮數。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《溫病條辨》. Composition: 金銀花、連翹、薄荷、荊芥、淡豆豉、牛蒡子、桔梗、竹葉、蘆根、甘草. cool-acrid exterior release, clears heat-toxin; for early warm disease / wind-heat: fever, mild chills, sore throat, thirst.

title: 桑菊飲（Sangju Yin）
summary: 解表劑。出自《溫病條辨》。組成：桑葉、菊花、杏仁、連翹、薄荷、桔梗、甘草、蘆根。疏風清熱、宣肺止咳；主治風溫初起、咳嗽為主、身熱不甚。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《溫病條辨》. Composition: 桑葉、菊花、杏仁、連翹、薄荷、桔梗、甘草、蘆根. disperses wind-heat, diffuses the lung, relieves cough; for early wind-warmth with cough and mild fever.

title: 麻杏石甘湯（Maxing Shigan Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：麻黃、杏仁、石膏、炙甘草。辛涼宣泄、清肺平喘；主治邪熱壅肺：身熱、喘咳、汗出、口渴、脈數。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 麻黃、杏仁、石膏、炙甘草. diffuses the lung, clears heat, calms wheezing; for lung heat: fever, cough and wheezing, sweating, thirst.

title: 升麻葛根湯（Shengma Gegen Tang）
summary: 解表劑。出自《閻氏小兒方論》。組成：升麻、葛根、芍藥、甘草。解肌透疹；主治麻疹初起未透。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《閻氏小兒方論》. Composition: 升麻、葛根、芍藥、甘草. releases the muscles, outthrusts rashes; for early measles with unexpressed rash.

title: 敗毒散（人參敗毒散）（Baidu San）
titleEn: Baidu San (敗毒散（人參敗毒散）)
summary: 解表劑。出自《小兒藥證直訣》。組成：羌活、獨活、柴胡、前胡、川芎、枳殼、桔梗、茯苓、人參、甘草、生薑、薄荷。散寒祛濕、益氣解表；主治氣虛外感風寒濕。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《小兒藥證直訣》. Composition: 羌活、獨活、柴胡、前胡、川芎、枳殼、桔梗、茯苓、人參、甘草、生薑、薄荷. dispels cold-damp, boosts qi, releases the exterior; for wind-cold-damp invasion in a qi-deficient patient.

title: 參蘇飲（Shensu Yin）
summary: 解表劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：人參、紫蘇葉、葛根、前胡、半夏、茯苓、陳皮、枳殼、桔梗、木香、甘草、生薑、大棗。益氣解表、理氣化痰；主治氣虛外感風寒、內有痰濕。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 人參、紫蘇葉、葛根、前胡、半夏、茯苓、陳皮、枳殼、桔梗、木香、甘草、生薑、大棗. boosts qi, releases the exterior, transforms phlegm; for qi deficiency with wind-cold and phlegm-damp.

title: 玉屏風散（Yupingfeng San）
summary: 解表劑。出自《醫方類聚》。組成：黃耆、白朮、防風。益氣固表止汗；主治表虛自汗、易感冒。
summaryEn: Exterior-releasing formulas. From 《醫方類聚》. Composition: 黃耆、白朮、防風. boosts qi, secures the exterior, stops sweating; for exterior deficiency with spontaneous sweating and frequent colds.

title: 大承氣湯（Da Chengqi Tang）
summary: 瀉下劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：大黃、厚朴、枳實、芒硝。峻下熱結；主治陽明腑實：痞滿燥實堅、潮熱譫語、脈沉實。
summaryEn: Purgative formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 大黃、厚朴、枳實、芒硝. drastically purges heat bind; for yangming bowel excess: fullness, dryness, hard stool, tidal fever, delirium.

title: 小承氣湯（Xiao Chengqi Tang）
summary: 瀉下劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：大黃、厚朴、枳實。輕下熱結；主治陽明腑實輕證。
summaryEn: Purgative formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 大黃、厚朴、枳實. mildly purges heat bind; for mild yangming bowel excess.

title: 調胃承氣湯（Tiaowei Chengqi Tang）
summary: 瀉下劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：大黃、芒硝、炙甘草。緩下熱結；主治陽明燥熱、便秘口渴。
summaryEn: Purgative formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 大黃、芒硝、炙甘草. moderately purges heat bind; for yangming dryness-heat with constipation.

title: 麻子仁丸（Maziren Wan）

summaryEn: Dryness-treating formulas. From 《重樓玉鑰》. Composition: 生地、麥冬、玄參、白芍、丹皮、貝母、薄荷、甘草. nourishes yin, clears the lung, benefits the throat; for diphtheria-type sore throat with yin deficiency.

title: 平胃散（Pingwei San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《簡要濟眾方》。組成：蒼朮、厚朴、陳皮、甘草、生薑、大棗。燥濕運脾、行氣和胃；主治濕滯脾胃：脘腹脹滿、苔白膩。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《簡要濟眾方》. Composition: 蒼朮、厚朴、陳皮、甘草、生薑、大棗. dries damp, moves the spleen, harmonises the stomach; for damp obstructing the spleen–stomach.

title: 藿香正氣散（Huoxiang Zhengqi San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：藿香、紫蘇、白芷、大腹皮、茯苓、白朮、半夏麴、陳皮、厚朴、桔梗、甘草、生薑、大棗。解表化濕、理氣和中；主治外感風寒、內傷濕滯（腸胃型感冒）。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 藿香、紫蘇、白芷、大腹皮、茯苓、白朮、半夏麴、陳皮、厚朴、桔梗、甘草、生薑、大棗. releases the exterior, transforms damp, regulates qi; for wind-cold with internal damp (gastroenteritis-type cold).

title: 茵陳蒿湯（Yinchenhao Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：茵陳、梔子、大黃。清熱利濕退黃；主治濕熱黃疸（陽黃）。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 茵陳、梔子、大黃. clears damp-heat, relieves jaundice; for damp-heat (yang) jaundice.

title: 八正散（Bazheng San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：車前子、瞿麥、萹蓄、滑石、梔子、炙甘草、木通、大黃、燈心草。清熱瀉火、利水通淋；主治濕熱淋證。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 車前子、瞿麥、萹蓄、滑石、梔子、炙甘草、木通、大黃、燈心草. clears heat, promotes urination; for damp-heat strangury (UTI).

title: 三仁湯（Sanren Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《溫病條辨》。組成：杏仁、白蔻仁、薏苡仁、厚朴、半夏、通草、滑石、竹葉。宣暢氣機、清利濕熱；主治濕溫初起、濕重於熱。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《溫病條辨》. Composition: 杏仁、白蔻仁、薏苡仁、厚朴、半夏、通草、滑石、竹葉. diffuses qi dynamics, clears damp-heat; for early damp-warmth with dampness predominant.

title: 甘露消毒丹（Ganlu Xiaodu Dan）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《醫效秘傳》。組成：滑石、茵陳、黃芩、石菖蒲、川貝、木通、藿香、射干、連翹、薄荷、白蔻仁。利濕化濁、清熱解毒；主治濕溫時疫、邪在氣分。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《醫效秘傳》. Composition: 滑石、茵陳、黃芩、石菖蒲、川貝、木通、藿香、射干、連翹、薄荷、白蔻仁. drains damp, resolves turbidity, clears heat-toxin; for damp-warmth epidemic at the qi level.

title: 連朴飲（Lianpo Yin）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《霍亂論》。組成：黃連、厚朴、石菖蒲、半夏、淡豆豉、梔子、蘆根。清熱化濕、理氣和中；主治濕熱霍亂（吐瀉）。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《霍亂論》. Composition: 黃連、厚朴、石菖蒲、半夏、淡豆豉、梔子、蘆根. clears heat, transforms damp, regulates qi; for damp-heat vomiting and diarrhoea.

title: 二妙散（Ermiao San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《丹溪心法》。組成：黃柏、蒼朮。清熱燥濕；主治濕熱下注之痿痹、帶下。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《丹溪心法》. Composition: 黃柏、蒼朮. clears heat, dries damp; for damp-heat descending: atrophy, discharge.

title: 五苓散（Wuling San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：豬苓、澤瀉、白朮、茯苓、桂枝。利水滲濕、溫陽化氣；主治蓄水證：小便不利、水腫、渴欲飲水、水入即吐。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 豬苓、澤瀉、白朮、茯苓、桂枝. drains water, warms yang, transforms qi; for water amassment: dysuria, oedema, thirst with vomiting.

title: 豬苓湯（Zhuling Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：豬苓、茯苓、澤瀉、阿膠、滑石。利水清熱養陰；主治水熱互結、陰虛小便不利。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 豬苓、茯苓、澤瀉、阿膠、滑石. drains water, clears heat, nourishes yin; for water–heat bind with yin deficiency.

title: 防己黃耆湯（Fangji Huangqi Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《金匱要略》。組成：防己、黃耆、白朮、甘草、生薑、大棗。益氣祛風、健脾利水；主治風水、風濕表虛：汗出惡風、身重浮腫。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《金匱要略》. Composition: 防己、黃耆、白朮、甘草、生薑、大棗. boosts qi, dispels wind, drains water; for wind-water with exterior deficiency.

title: 五皮散（Wupi San）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《華氏中藏經》。組成：生薑皮、桑白皮、陳皮、大腹皮、茯苓皮。利水消腫、理氣健脾；主治皮水（全身水腫）。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《華氏中藏經》. Composition: 生薑皮、桑白皮、陳皮、大腹皮、茯苓皮. drains water, reduces oedema; for skin oedema.

title: 苓桂朮甘湯（Linggui Zhugan Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《金匱要略》。組成：茯苓、桂枝、白朮、炙甘草。溫陽化飲、健脾利濕；主治痰飲：胸脅支滿、目眩心悸。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《金匱要略》. Composition: 茯苓、桂枝、白朮、炙甘草. warms yang, transforms rheum; for phlegm-rheum: chest fullness, dizziness, palpitations.

title: 真武湯（Zhenwu Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：附子、茯苓、白朮、芍藥、生薑。溫陽利水；主治脾腎陽虛水泛：水腫、小便不利、四肢沉重。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 附子、茯苓、白朮、芍藥、生薑. warms yang, drains water; for spleen–kidney yang deficiency with water flooding.

title: 實脾飲（Shipi Yin）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《重訂嚴氏濟生方》。組成：厚朴、白朮、木瓜、木香、草果、大腹子、附子、茯苓、乾薑、炙甘草、生薑、大棗。溫陽健脾、行氣利水；主治陽虛水腫（陰水）。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《重訂嚴氏濟生方》. Composition: 厚朴、白朮、木瓜、木香、草果、大腹子、附子、茯苓、乾薑、炙甘草、生薑、大棗. warms yang, fortifies the spleen, drains water; for yin oedema.

title: 萆薢分清飲（Bixie Fenqing Yin）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《楊氏家藏方》。組成：萆薢、益智仁、石菖蒲、烏藥。溫腎利濕、分清化濁；主治下焦虛寒之膏淋白濁。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《楊氏家藏方》. Composition: 萆薢、益智仁、石菖蒲、烏藥. warms the kidney, separates clear from turbid; for unctuous strangury from lower-burner cold.

title: 羌活勝濕湯（Qianghuo Shengshi Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《內外傷辨惑論》。組成：羌活、獨活、藁本、防風、炙甘草、川芎、蔓荊子。祛風勝濕止痛；主治風濕在表之頭身重痛。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《內外傷辨惑論》. Composition: 羌活、獨活、藁本、防風、炙甘草、川芎、蔓荊子. dispels wind-damp, relieves pain; for wind-damp in the exterior: heavy painful body.

title: 獨活寄生湯（Duhuo Jisheng Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《備急千金要方》。組成：獨活、桑寄生、杜仲、牛膝、細辛、秦艽、茯苓、肉桂、防風、川芎、人參、甘草、當歸、芍藥、乾地黃。祛風濕、止痹痛、益肝腎、補氣血；主治痹證日久、肝腎兩虛、氣血不足。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《備急千金要方》. Composition: 獨活、桑寄生、杜仲、牛膝、細辛、秦艽、茯苓、肉桂、防風、川芎、人參、甘草、當歸、芍藥、乾地黃. dispels wind-damp, relieves bi, tonifies liver–kidney and qi–blood; for chronic bi with liver–kidney and qi–blood deficiency.

title: 二陳湯（Erchen Tang）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：半夏、橘紅、茯苓、炙甘草、生薑、烏梅。燥濕化痰、理氣和中；主治濕痰證：咳嗽痰多色白。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 半夏、橘紅、茯苓、炙甘草、生薑、烏梅. dries damp, transforms phlegm, regulates qi; for damp-phlegm: cough with copious white sputum.

title: 溫膽湯（Wendan Tang）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《三因極一病證方論》。組成：半夏、竹茹、枳實、陳皮、茯苓、甘草、生薑、大棗。理氣化痰、清膽和胃；主治膽鬱痰擾：虛煩不眠、驚悸、嘔吐。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《三因極一病證方論》. Composition: 半夏、竹茹、枳實、陳皮、茯苓、甘草、生薑、大棗. regulates qi, transforms phlegm, clears the gallbladder; for gallbladder constraint with phlegm: insomnia, palpitations.

title: 清氣化痰丸（Qingqi Huatan Wan）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《醫方考》。組成：膽南星、瓜蔞仁、黃芩、陳皮、杏仁、枳實、茯苓、半夏。清熱化痰、理氣止咳；主治痰熱咳嗽。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《醫方考》. Composition: 膽南星、瓜蔞仁、黃芩、陳皮、杏仁、枳實、茯苓、半夏. clears heat, transforms phlegm; for phlegm-heat cough.

title: 貝母瓜蔞散（Beimu Gualou San）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《醫學心悟》。組成：貝母、瓜蔞、天花粉、茯苓、橘紅、桔梗。潤肺清熱、理氣化痰；主治燥痰咳嗽。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《醫學心悟》. Composition: 貝母、瓜蔞、天花粉、茯苓、橘紅、桔梗. moistens the lung, transforms phlegm; for dry-phlegm cough.

title: 三子養親湯（Sanzi Yangqin Tang）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《韓氏醫通》。組成：紫蘇子、白芥子、萊菔子。降氣快膈、化痰消食；主治痰壅氣逆食滯（老人）。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《韓氏醫通》. Composition: 紫蘇子、白芥子、萊菔子. downbears qi, transforms phlegm, disperses food; for phlegm with food stagnation in the elderly.

title: 半夏白朮天麻湯（Banxia Baizhu Tianma Tang）
titleEn: Banxia Baizhu Tianma Tang (半夏白朮天麻湯)
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《醫學心悟》。組成：半夏、天麻、白朮、茯苓、橘紅、甘草、生薑、大棗。化痰息風、健脾祛濕；主治風痰上擾之眩暈頭痛。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《醫學心悟》. Composition: 半夏、天麻、白朮、茯苓、橘紅、甘草、生薑、大棗. transforms phlegm, extinguishes wind; for dizziness and headache from wind-phlegm.

title: 止嗽散（Zhisou San）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《醫學心悟》。組成：紫菀、百部、白前、桔梗、荊芥、陳皮、甘草。宣利肺氣、疏風止咳；主治風邪犯肺之咳嗽（感冒後久咳）。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《醫學心悟》. Composition: 紫菀、百部、白前、桔梗、荊芥、陳皮、甘草. diffuses lung qi, relieves cough; for post-cold lingering cough.

title: 小陷胸湯（Xiao Xianxiong Tang）
summary: 祛痰劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：黃連、半夏、瓜蔞。清熱化痰、寬胸散結；主治痰熱互結之小結胸。
summaryEn: Phlegm-dispelling formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 黃連、半夏、瓜蔞. clears heat, transforms phlegm, loosens the chest; for phlegm-heat binding in the chest.

title: 保和丸（Baohe Wan）
summary: 消食劑。出自《丹溪心法》。組成：山楂、神麴、半夏、茯苓、陳皮、連翹、萊菔子。消食和胃；主治食積停滯：脘腹脹滿、噯腐吞酸。
summaryEn: Food-dispersing formulas. From 《丹溪心法》. Composition: 山楂、神麴、半夏、茯苓、陳皮、連翹、萊菔子. disperses food, harmonises the stomach; for food stagnation.

title: 枳實導滯丸（Zhishi Daozhi Wan）
summary: 消食劑。出自《內外傷辨惑論》。組成：大黃、枳實、神麴、茯苓、黃芩、黃連、白朮、澤瀉。消食導滯、清熱祛濕；主治濕熱食積。
summaryEn: Food-dispersing formulas. From 《內外傷辨惑論》. Composition: 大黃、枳實、神麴、茯苓、黃芩、黃連、白朮、澤瀉. disperses food, drains heat and damp; for damp-heat food accumulation.

title: 健脾丸（Jianpi Wan）
summary: 消食劑。出自《證治準繩》。組成：白朮、木香、黃連、甘草、茯苓、人參、神麴、陳皮、砂仁、麥芽、山楂、山藥、肉豆蔻。健脾和胃、消食止瀉；主治脾虛食積。
summaryEn: Food-dispersing formulas. From 《證治準繩》. Composition: 白朮、木香、黃連、甘草、茯苓、人參、神麴、陳皮、砂仁、麥芽、山楂、山藥、肉豆蔻. fortifies the spleen, disperses food, stops diarrhoea; for spleen deficiency with food stagnation.

title: 枳朮丸（Zhizhu Wan）
summary: 消食劑。出自《脾胃論》。組成：白朮、枳實。健脾消痞；主治脾虛氣滯之痞滿。
summaryEn: Food-dispersing formulas. From 《脾胃論》. Composition: 白朮、枳實. fortifies the spleen, disperses pi; for spleen deficiency with qi stagnation.

title: 烏梅丸（Wumei Wan）
summary: 驅蟲與湧吐劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：烏梅、細辛、乾薑、黃連、當歸、附子、蜀椒、桂枝、人參、黃柏。溫臟安蛔；主治蛔厥、寒熱錯雜久痢。
summaryEn: Anthelmintic and emetic formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 烏梅、細辛、乾薑、黃連、當歸、附子、蜀椒、桂枝、人參、黃柏. warms the organs, calms roundworms; for roundworm reversal; chronic cold-heat dysentery.

title: 瓜蒂散（Guadi San）
summary: 驅蟲與湧吐劑。出自《傷寒論》。組成：瓜蒂、赤小豆。湧吐痰涎宿食；主治痰涎宿食壅滯胸脘。
summaryEn: Anthelmintic and emetic formulas. From 《傷寒論》. Composition: 瓜蒂、赤小豆. induces vomiting; for phlegm and food stagnating in the chest.

title: 仙方活命飲（Xianfang Huoming Yin）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《校注婦人良方》。組成：金銀花、白芷、貝母、防風、赤芍、當歸尾、甘草、皂角刺、穿山甲（代）、天花粉、乳香、沒藥。清熱解毒、消腫潰堅、活血止痛；主治陽證癰瘍腫毒初起。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《校注婦人良方》. Composition: 金銀花、白芷、貝母、防風、赤芍、當歸尾、甘草、皂角刺、穿山甲（代）、天花粉、乳香、沒藥. clears heat-toxin, reduces swelling, quickens blood; for early yang sores.

title: 五味消毒飲（Wuwei Xiaodu Yin）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《醫宗金鑒》。組成：金銀花、野菊花、蒲公英、紫花地丁、紫背天葵子。清熱解毒、消散疔瘡；主治疔瘡癰腫。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《醫宗金鑒》. Composition: 金銀花、野菊花、蒲公英、紫花地丁、紫背天葵子. clears heat-toxin, disperses furuncles; for furuncles and boils.

title: 大黃牡丹湯（Dahuang Mudan Tang）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《金匱要略》。組成：大黃、丹皮、桃仁、冬瓜仁、芒硝。瀉熱破瘀、散結消腫；主治腸癰初起（闌尾炎）。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《金匱要略》. Composition: 大黃、丹皮、桃仁、冬瓜仁、芒硝. drains heat, breaks stasis; for early intestinal abscess (appendicitis).

title: 透膿散（Tounong San）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《外科正宗》。組成：黃耆、穿山甲（代）、川芎、當歸、皂角刺。托毒透膿；主治癰瘍膿成不潰。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《外科正宗》. Composition: 黃耆、穿山甲（代）、川芎、當歸、皂角刺. supports zheng, expels pus; for mature abscess not draining.

title: 如意金黃散（Ruyi Jinhuang San）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《外科正宗》。組成：天花粉、黃柏、大黃、薑黃、白芷、厚朴、陳皮、甘草、蒼朮、天南星。清熱解毒、消腫止痛（外敷）；主治陽證瘡瘍紅腫。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《外科正宗》. Composition: 天花粉、黃柏、大黃、薑黃、白芷、厚朴、陳皮、甘草、蒼朮、天南星. clears heat-toxin, reduces swelling (topical); for red swollen yang sores.

title: 生肌玉紅膏（Shengji Yuhong Gao）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自《外科正宗》。組成：當歸、白芷、白蠟、輕粉、甘草、紫草、血竭、麻油。解毒消腫、生肌止痛（外用）；主治瘡瘍潰後不斂。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 《外科正宗》. Composition: 當歸、白芷、白蠟、輕粉、甘草、紫草、血竭、麻油. resolves toxin, generates flesh (topical); for non-healing ulcers.

title: 雲南白藥（Yunnan Baiyao）
summary: 癰瘍與外用劑。出自現代成方。組成：三七等（保密配方）。化瘀止血、活血止痛；主治跌打損傷出血。
summaryEn: Sore and external formulas. From 現代成方. Composition: 三七等（保密配方）. transforms stasis, stops bleeding; for traumatic bleeding.

title: 十全大補湯（Shiquan Dabu Tang）
summary: 補益劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：八珍湯＋黃耆、肉桂。溫補氣血；主治氣血兩虛偏寒。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 八珍湯＋黃耆、肉桂. warms and tonifies qi and blood; for dual qi–blood deficiency with cold.

title: 人參養榮湯（Renshen Yangrong Tang）
summary: 補益劑。出自《太平惠民和劑局方》。組成：人參、黃耆、白朮、茯苓、炙甘草、當歸、熟地、白芍、肉桂、陳皮、遠志、五味子、生薑、大棗。益氣補血、養心安神；主治氣血兩虛兼心神不寧。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《太平惠民和劑局方》. Composition: 人參、黃耆、白朮、茯苓、炙甘草、當歸、熟地、白芍、肉桂、陳皮、遠志、五味子、生薑、大棗. boosts qi, nourishes blood, calms the spirit; for qi–blood deficiency with restless spirit.

title: 補肺湯（Bufei Tang）
summary: 補益劑。出自《永類鈐方》。組成：人參、黃耆、熟地、五味子、紫菀、桑白皮。補肺益氣、止咳平喘；主治肺氣虛咳喘。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《永類鈐方》. Composition: 人參、黃耆、熟地、五味子、紫菀、桑白皮. tonifies the lung, relieves cough; for lung qi deficiency cough.

title: 黃耆桂枝五物湯（Huangqi Guizhi Wuwu Tang）
titleEn: Huangqi Guizhi Wuwu Tang (黃耆桂枝五物湯)
summary: 補益劑。出自《金匱要略》。組成：黃耆、桂枝、芍藥、生薑、大棗。益氣溫經、和血通痹；主治血痹（肌膚麻木）。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《金匱要略》. Composition: 黃耆、桂枝、芍藥、生薑、大棗. boosts qi, warms the channels, frees bi; for blood bi: numbness (neuropathy).

title: 清肺排毒湯（Qingfei Paidu Tang）
summary: 清熱劑。出自現代（2020）。組成：麻杏石甘湯＋射干麻黃湯＋小柴胡湯＋五苓散加減。宣肺化濕、清熱解毒；主治COVID-19 輕中症（中國方案經驗）。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing formulas. From 現代（2020）. Composition: 麻杏石甘湯＋射干麻黃湯＋小柴胡湯＋五苓散加減. diffuses the lung, transforms damp, clears heat-toxin; for COVID-19 mild–moderate (Chinese protocol experience).

title: 清冠一號（NRICM101）
summary: 清熱劑。出自台灣國家中醫藥研究所（2021）。組成：黃芩、魚腥草、北板藍根、栝樓實、荊芥、防風、薄荷、桑葉、厚朴、甘草。清熱解毒、宣肺化痰；主治COVID-19 輔助治療（台灣）。
summaryEn: Heat-clearing formulas. From 台灣國家中醫藥研究所（2021）. Composition: 黃芩、魚腥草、北板藍根、栝樓實、荊芥、防風、薄荷、桑葉、厚朴、甘草. clears heat-toxin, diffuses the lung, transforms phlegm; for COVID-19 adjunct (Taiwan NRICM).

title: 加味逍遙散（Jiawei Xiaoyao San）
summary: 和解劑。出自《內科摘要》。組成：逍遙散＋丹皮、梔子。疏肝清熱、健脾養血；主治肝鬱化火：煩躁易怒、潮熱、月經不調。
summaryEn: Harmonising formulas. From 《內科摘要》. Composition: 逍遙散＋丹皮、梔子. courses the liver, clears heat, nourishes blood; for liver constraint with fire: irritability, hot flushes.

title: 香砂六君子湯（Xiangsha Liujunzi Tang）
titleEn: Xiangsha Liujunzi Tang (香砂六君子湯)
summary: 理氣劑。出自《古今名醫方論》。組成：六君子湯＋木香、砂仁。益氣健脾、行氣化痰；主治脾胃氣虛、痰阻氣滯之脘腹脹痛。
summaryEn: Qi-regulating formulas. From 《古今名醫方論》. Composition: 六君子湯＋木香、砂仁. boosts qi, fortifies the spleen, moves qi; for spleen qi deficiency with phlegm and qi stagnation.

title: 杞菊地黃丸（Qiju Dihuang Wan）
summary: 補益劑。出自《醫級》。組成：六味地黃丸＋枸杞、菊花。滋腎養肝明目；主治肝腎陰虛之目疾。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《醫級》. Composition: 六味地黃丸＋枸杞、菊花. enriches kidney and liver, brightens eyes; for eye disorders from liver–kidney yin deficiency.

title: 知柏地黃丸（Zhibai Dihuang Wan）
summary: 補益劑。出自《醫方考》。組成：六味地黃丸＋知母、黃柏。滋陰降火；主治陰虛火旺：骨蒸潮熱、盜汗、遺精。
summaryEn: Tonifying formulas. From 《醫方考》. Composition: 六味地黃丸＋知母、黃柏. enriches yin, downbears fire; for yin deficiency fire.

title: 當歸拈痛湯（Danggui Niantong Tang）
summary: 祛濕劑。出自《醫學啟源》。組成：羌活、防風、升麻、葛根、白朮、蒼朮、當歸、人參、甘草、苦參、黃芩、知母、茵陳、豬苓、澤瀉。利濕清熱、疏風止痛；主治濕熱相搏之肢節煩痛、瘡瘍。
summaryEn: Dampness-dispelling formulas. From 《醫學啟源》. Composition: 羌活、防風、升麻、葛根、白朮、蒼朮、當歸、人參、甘草、苦參、黃芩、知母、茵陳、豬苓、澤瀉. drains damp, clears heat, disperses wind; for damp-heat joint pain and sores.

title: 小續命湯（Xiao Xuming Tang）
summary: 治風劑。出自《備急千金要方》。組成：麻黃、防己、人參、黃芩、桂心、甘草、芍藥、川芎、杏仁、附子、防風、生薑。祛風扶正；主治中風（外風）。
summaryEn: Wind-treating formulas. From 《備急千金要方》. Composition: 麻黃、防己、人參、黃芩、桂心、甘草、芍藥、川芎、杏仁、附子、防風、生薑. dispels wind, supports zheng; for wind stroke of the external-wind type.

title: 少腹逐瘀湯（Shaofu Zhuyu Tang）
summary: 理血劑。出自《醫林改錯》。組成：小茴香、乾薑、延胡索、沒藥、當歸、川芎、肉桂、赤芍、蒲黃、五靈脂。活血祛瘀、溫經止痛；主治少腹寒凝血瘀之痛經、不孕。
summaryEn: Blood-regulating formulas. From 《醫林改錯》. Composition: 小茴香、乾薑、延胡索、沒藥、當歸、川芎、肉桂、赤芍、蒲黃、五靈脂. quickens blood, warms the channels; for cold-stasis dysmenorrhoea and infertility.

title: 膈下逐瘀湯（Gexia Zhuyu Tang）
summary: 理血劑。出自《醫林改錯》。組成：五靈脂、當歸、川芎、桃仁、丹皮、赤芍、烏藥、延胡索、甘草、香附、紅花、枳殼。活血祛瘀、行氣止痛；主治膈下瘀血之積塊、痛經。
summaryEn: Blood-regulating formulas. From 《醫林改錯》. Composition: 五靈脂、當歸、川芎、桃仁、丹皮、赤芍、烏藥、延胡索、甘草、香附、紅花、枳殼. quickens blood, moves qi; for stasis below the diaphragm: masses, dysmenorrhoea.

title: 身痛逐瘀湯（Shentong Zhuyu Tang）
summary: 理血劑。出自《醫林改錯》。組成：秦艽、川芎、桃仁、紅花、甘草、羌活、沒藥、當歸、五靈脂、香附、牛膝、地龍。活血行氣、祛瘀通絡、通痹止痛；主治瘀血痹阻之肢體疼痛。
summaryEn: Blood-regulating formulas. From 《醫林改錯》. Composition: 秦艽、川芎、桃仁、紅花、甘草、羌活、沒藥、當歸、五靈脂、香附、牛膝、地龍. quickens blood, frees the collaterals, relieves bi pain; for bi pain from stasis.

title: 通竅活血湯（Tongqiao Huoxue Tang）
summary: 理血劑。出自《醫林改錯》。組成：赤芍、川芎、桃仁、紅花、老蔥、生薑、紅棗、麝香、黃酒。活血通竅；主治頭面瘀血：頭痛、耳聾、脫髮。
summaryEn: Blood-regulating formulas. From 《醫林改錯》. Composition: 赤芍、川芎、桃仁、紅花、老蔥、生薑、紅棗、麝香、黃酒. quickens blood, opens the orifices; for stasis of the head: headache, deafness, hair loss.
